cbeebies.uk.title: Hey Duggee: Top of the Pups
cbeebies.uk.description: Wheels on the Bus. The Squirrels go on a bus ride with Duggee as they sing 'Wheels on the Bus'. [S,AD]

cbeebies.uk.title: Chantelle and Rory's Teeny Tiny Creatures

cbeebies.uk.title: Our Family

cbeebies.uk.title: Big Cook Little Cook

cbeebies.uk.title: Aneeshwar and Lizzie Go Wild

cbeebies.uk.title: What's in Your Bag

cbeebies.uk.title: Waffle's After School Club

cbeebies.uk.title: Puffin Rock
cbeebies.uk.description: Night Lights. Oona makes her first night-time trip to the sea - all on her own! [S,AD]

cbeebies.uk.title: Yukee

cbeebies.uk.title: Lu & the Bally Bunch
cbeebies.uk.description: Find the Blueberries. Lu and Biba accidentally rig their treasure hunt game.

cbeebies.uk.title: Piggy Builders

cbeebies.uk.title: Numberblocks

cbeebies.uk.title: Something Special: We're All Friends

cbeebies.uk.title: Ranger Hamza's Eco Quest

cbeebies.uk.title: Peter Rabbit

utv.uk.title: Deal or No Deal - Amanda
utv.uk.description: The iconic TV series is back, but in a brand-new setting with brand-new prize boxes and a new batch of contestants hoping to win a whopping cash prize - who will have what it takes to beat our brand-new Banker? Now hosted by Stephen Mulhern, the series will see contestants battle it out against the notorious Banker to be in with a chance of winning a life-changing cash prize in a nail-biting game of nerves and intuition. Contestants are confronted with 22 sealed boxes with each one hiding a different amount of money - without knowing what each one contains, the contestant must eliminate the boxes, which are opened one at a time, and the amount of money inside is revealed. Pressure mounts as the player is tempted by the notorious Banker to accept an offer of cash in exchange for what might be inside their box, and as long as the larger cash prizes remain unchosen, the Banker's offers will get higher... but that can all change in an instant if a big cash prize is unveiled. (Comedy, Family, Reality) - 2005

With extremes happening more frequently, and at unprecedented times, across all our seasons. Impacts of climate change are no longer a future prospect for future generations. The country is facing them now, with every area of life affected.

bbconemidlands.uk.description: S2 E6 The tragic events of the party send shockwaves through the Phelans. As dangerous secrets threaten to come to light, Michael is forced to make a difficult confession to Diana. Meanwhile, unseen dangers close in, and it becomes clear no-one is safe.

bbconemidlands.uk.title: Dashcam Justice
bbconemidlands.uk.description: S1 E2 A high-speed road rage battle on the M4 ends with a car flipping across the motorway. Both drivers deny wrongdoing, but another motorist's dashcam captures the drama. A shortcut down a country lane leaves Susie Martin facing a head-on crash and an angry driver determined to blame her, and a warning horn helps avert disaster as a car bears down on a woman and child at a zebra crossing.

bbconemidlands.uk.title: Escape to the Country
bbconemidlands.uk.description: S22 E6 East Midlands Ginny Buckley helps three generations of one family who want to move to the East Midlands, with mum and grandma weighing up the properties that have been uncovered. Away from houses, Ginny meets a volunteer group helping to restore the area's local canals and their footpaths so that wildlife can thrive and the public can enjoy a safer stroll.

bbconemidlands.uk.title: Stacey & Joe: In Too Deep
bbconemidlands.uk.description: S3 E1 All the Gear, No Idea A glimpse into the daily lives of Stacey Solomon, Joe Swash and their children. Joe has big plans for the fishing lake, and appoints Stacey as project manager. An encounter with a paparazzo reminds Stacey that life in the spotlight has its downsides, but things take an upturn with a double birthday celebration at Pickle House - and Joe spots an emu at a fishery and instantly falls in love.

Meanwhile, back in the eighth century, a tale of monks and Vikings reveals the true value of the buried treasure everyone is looking for. Drama, starring Ella Lily Hyland, Casey Walsh, Aidan Gillen and Brian Doherty.

amc.us.title: What About Bob?
amc.us.description: Before going on vacation, self-involved psychiatrist Dr. Leo Marvin (Richard Dreyfuss) has the misfortune of taking on a new patient: Bob Wiley (Bill Murray). An exemplar of neediness and a compendium of phobias, Bob follows Marvin to his family's country house. Dr. Marvin tries to get him to leave; the trouble is, everyone love Bob. As his oblivious patient makes himself at home, Dr. Marvin loses his professional composure and, before long, may be ready for the loony bin himself. (Drama) - 1991

amc.us.title: Captain Phillips
amc.us.description: In April 2009, the U.S. container ship Maersk Alabama sails toward its destination on a day that seems like any other. Suddenly, Somali pirates race toward the vessel, climb aboard and take everyone hostage. The captain of the ship, Richard Phillips, looks to protect his crew from the hostile invaders, and their leader, Muse. The pirates are after millions of dollars, and Phillips must use his wits to make sure everyone survives and returns home safely. (Docudrama, Action, Thriller, Crime drama, Biography) - 2013

amc.us.title: John Wick: Chapter 3 -- Parabellum
amc.us.description: After gunning down a member of the High Table -- the shadowy international assassin's guild -- legendary hit man John Wick finds himself stripped of the organization's protective services. Now stuck with a $14 million bounty on his head, Wick must fight his way through the streets of New York as he becomes the target of the world's most ruthless killers. (Action, Thriller, Adventure, Mystery, Crime drama) - 2019

amc.us.title: John Wick: Chapter 4
amc.us.description: With the price on his head ever-increasing, legendary hit man John Wick takes his fight against the High Table global as he seeks out the most powerful players in the underworld, from New York to Paris to Japan to Berlin. (Action) - 2023

amc.us.title: Knives Out
amc.us.description: The circumstances surrounding the death of crime novelist Harlan Thrombey are mysterious, but there's one thing that renowned Detective Benoit Blanc knows for sure -- everyone in the wildly dysfunctional Thrombey family is a suspect. Now, Blanc must sift through a web of lies and red herrings to uncover the truth. (Mystery, Crime drama, Comedy, Thriller) - 2019

amc.us.title: Cast Away
amc.us.description: Obsessively punctual FedEx executive Chuck Noland (Tom Hanks) is en route to an assignment in Malaysia when his plane crashes over the Pacific Ocean during a storm. The sole survivor of the flight, Chuck washes ashore on a deserted island. When his efforts to sail away and contact help fail, Chuck learns how to survive on the island, where he remains for years, accompanied by only his handmade volleyball friend, Wilson. Will Chuck ever return to civilization and reunite with his loved ones? (Drama, Adventure, Romance) - 2000

amc.us.title: Turner & Hooch
amc.us.description: Det. Scott Turner (Tom Hanks) is an uptight, by-the-book police officer who hopes to leave his sleepy California town and work in the big city. When his friend Amos Reed (John McIntire), the proprietor of a junkyard, is killed, Turner reluctantly inherits the man's dog. Realizing that the canine may be able to help him solve the murder case, Turner attempts to adjust to life with the big dog, resulting in much household destruction and unwelcome chaos. cinemax.us.title: Hoot
cinemax.us.description: Roy Eberhardt (Logan Lerman) has moved so often he has lost track of how many times he has changed schools. After moving from Montana to Florida's Gulf Coast, he befriends Beatrice (Brie Larson) and her brother. The siblings show Roy their hideaway, where they secretly take care of a flock of wild owls. When they learn that a restaurant will be built where the owls live, the three decide to enlist the help of a local policeman (Luke Wilson) to save the birds. (Children, Comedy, Adventure) - 2006

cinemax.us.title: Solace
cinemax.us.description: A psychic and a federal agent hunt a serial killer. (Thriller, Mystery, Crime drama) - 2015

cinemax.us.title: It
cinemax.us.description: In 1960, seven preteen outcasts fight an evil demon that poses as a child-killing clown. Thirty years later, they reunite to stop the demon once and for all when it returns to their hometown. (Drama, Fantasy, Horror, Mystery, Thriller) - 1990

cinemax.us.title: Enemy
cinemax.us.description: A mild-mannered college professor (Jake Gyllenhaal) discovers a look-alike actor and delves into the other man's private affairs. (Thriller) - 2013

cinemax.us.title: William Shakespeare's Romeo & Juliet
cinemax.us.description: Baz Luhrmann helped adapt this classic Shakespearean romantic tragedy for the screen, updating the setting to a post-modern city named Verona Beach. In this version, the Capulets and the Montagues are two rival gangs. Juliet is attending a costume ball thrown by her parents. Her father Fulgencio Capulet has arranged her marriage to the boorish Paris as part of a strategic investment plan. Romeo attends the masked ball and he and Juliet fall in love. (Romance, Drama) - 1996

cinemax.us.title: Us
cinemax.us.description: Accompanied by her husband, son and daughter, Adelaide Wilson returns to the beachfront home where she grew up as a child. Haunted by a traumatic experience from the past, Adelaide grows increasingly concerned that something bad is going to happen. Her worst fears soon become a reality when four masked strangers descend upon the house, forcing the Wilsons into a fight for survival. When the masks come off, the family is horrified to learn that each attacker takes the appearance of one of them. (Horror, Thriller) - 2019

cinemax.us.title: 3 Days to Kill
cinemax.us.description: Facing a terminal disease, spy Ethan Renner (Kevin Costner) has decided to give up his dangerous, high-stakes life in order to rebuild his relationship with his estranged wife and daughter (Hailee Steinfeld), whom he previously pushed away to keep them out of harm's way. However, in exchange for a potentially lifesaving drug, he must complete one final mission: apprehend one of the world's most ruthless terrorists while looking after his teenage offspring in her mother's absence. (Action, Thriller, Adventure) - 2014

cinemax.us.title: The Adjustment Bureau
cinemax.us.description: Just as he is on the brink of winning a Senate seat, politician David Norris meets a ballerina named Elise Sellas. Though David is instantly smitten, mysterious men conspire to keep him away from the beautiful dancer. David learns that he is facing the powerful agents of Fate itself, and glimpsing the future laid out for him, must either accept a predetermined path that does not include Elise or else defy Fate to be with her. (Thriller, Romance, Science fiction, Crime drama) - 2011

cinemax.us.title: The Nun
cinemax.us.description: When a young nun at a cloistered abbey in Romania takes her own life, a priest with a haunted past and a novitiate on the threshold of her final vows are sent by the Vatican to investigate. Together, they uncover the order's unholy secret. Risking not only their lives but their faith and their very souls, they confront a malevolent force in the form of a demonic nun. (Horror, Thriller) - 2018

cookingchannel.us.title: Burgers, Brew & 'Que - Smoked Whole Hog
cookingchannel.us.description: Michael Symon heads to Asheville, N.C., where he smokes a whole hog in traditional Carolina style for the juiciest pulled pork sandwich; beignets stuffed with crawfish, shrimp and andouille sausage; burger with Atomic Death sauce and Hell Relish. (Cooking, Travel) - 2018-08-14

cookingchannel.us.title: Burgers, Brew & 'Que - Super Smoked and Savory
cookingchannel.us.description: Juiciest, meatiest, triple-stacked burger with beef, lamb and turkey; authentic Mexican lamb barbacoa wrapped in fresh banana leaves; one barbecue joint is smoking everything from meatloaf to turkey tacos and even their guacamole. (Cooking, Travel) - 2018-10-02

cookingchannel.us.title: Burgers, Brew & 'Que - Meat Lover's Madness
cookingchannel.us.description: A Cleveland brewery that revolutionizes pub fare with decadent confit chicken wings in chipotle-maple glaze; brisket, bacon and ham on top of a four-cut blended steak patty. (Cooking, Travel) - 2019-01-08

cookingchannel.us.title: Burgers, Brew & 'Que - Bacon Behemoths
cookingchannel.us.description: A traditional Rhode Island hot wiener in a crêpe topped with chili; a steak patty topped with Chinese char siu slaw and nestled inside a soft steamed bao bun; cold-smoked baby back ribs on a bed of flaming hay; an 18-ounce bacon steak. (Cooking, Travel) - 2019-03-04

cookingchannel.us.title: Burgers, Brew & 'Que - Smoked, Stuffed and Smothered
cookingchannel.us.description: Michael Symon takes on a dumpling-inspired pork and shrimp burger; a wood-fired pizza topped with spicy roast chicken and sweet corn; pulled pork on a cornbread waffle and smoked meatballs with a cheesy surprise inside. (Cooking, Travel) - 2020-01-28

cookingchannel.us.title: Burgers, Brew & 'Que - Southern, Spicy and Sweet
cookingchannel.us.description: Bobby Flay makes a surprise guest appearance at a barbecue joint in New York with a one-of-a-kind brontosaurus beef rib; in Nashville, the local tradition is hot chicken; in Cleveland, the brunch burger. (Cooking, Travel) - 2017-03-28

cookingchannel.us.title: Unique Eats - Fried Food
cookingchannel.us.description: Twenty-five different toppings to go with poutine; a fish and chips shop that offers different fish and batters; fried risotto balls go gourmet with unique sweet and savory fillings; big fat doughnuts are piled high. (Travel, Cooking) - 2011-07-10

cookingchannel.us.title: Unique Eats - Hot Spots
cookingchannel.us.description: A San Francisco legend turns Chinese food on its head; a New York City favorite where American classics get a twist. (Travel, Cooking) - 2012-05-27

cookingchannel.us.title: Unique Eats - Nostalgic Noshes
cookingchannel.us.description: Classics with a new twist. (Travel, Cooking) - 2012-06-16

cookingchannel.us.title: Unique Eats - Guilty Pleasures
cookingchannel.us.description: Restaurants offer comfort foods. (Travel, Cooking) - 2013-02-24

cookingchannel.us.title: Unique Eats - New Asian
cookingchannel.us.description: An authentic ramen house in Austin, Texas; a gastropub in Miami serves Asian-inspired pork; traditional Thai food; brunch favorites are transformed into Asian noodle dishes in Brooklyn. (Travel, Cooking) - 2013-09-29

cookingchannel.us.title: Unique Eats - Great Spaces
cookingchannel.us.description: A food truck serving the most delectable Korean/Mexican dishes; a bowling alley that boasts its own special Blue Ribbon menu; a locally-inspired private farm table dinner. (Travel, Cooking) - 2010-08-16

cookingchannel.us.title: Bizarre Foods America - Undiscovered Hawaii
cookingchannel.us.description: Andrew wants to find out what Hawaiians really like to eat; dried octopus bile sac; crispy pork intestine;and a traditional take on a raw fish salad that includes the eyeballs. (Travel, Cooking) - 2013-07-08

cookingchannel.us.title: Bizarre Foods America - San Francisco Bay: Cricket Cookies & Engineered Eggs
cookingchannel.us.description: Andrew Zimmern visits San Francisco's Bay Area; Cookies made with crickets; eggs made out of plants; lamb's head soup. (Travel, Cooking) - 2013-12-23

cookingchannel.us.title: Bizarre Foods America - Birmingham: The New South
cookingchannel.us.description: A Chinese style noodle bowl made with frog legs and pig skin; sautéed rabbit offal and goat head soup. (Travel, Cooking) - 2013-07-29

cookingchannel.us.title: Bizarre Foods America - New Orleans
cookingchannel.us.description: Bizarre Foods America visits the Big Easy where the food and the culture are a mix of Southern traditions and modern influence. Andrew eats stuffed pig stomach and smoked raccoon served with a side of live jazz. (Travel, Cooking) - 2012-01-30

cookingchannel.us.title: Bizarre Foods America - Detroit
cookingchannel.us.description: Andrew finds out if it is food that keeps Detroit's motor running. Andrew visits Motown and gets revved up about tasting some of the city's food, including iconic soul food and lamb brain sandwiches, in the heart of Arab America. (Travel, Cooking) - 2012-02-20

cookingchannel.us.title: Bizarre Foods America - West Virginia
cookingchannel.us.description: West Virginia's culinary delights are celebrated, including fresh deer organs after a kill, groundhog burgoo, and a roadkill cook-off. (Travel, Cooking) - 2012-02-27

cookingchannel.us.title: Man v. Food - Newark, New Jersey
cookingchannel.us.description: Casey Webb heads to his home state of New Jersey for an iconic Italian hot dog, a Portuguese pork sandwich, and a taco challenge so big that no one's been brave enough to try it. (Travel, Cooking) - 2022-01-04

cookingchannel.us.title: Man v. Food - Buffalo, New York

cookingchannel.us.title: Man v. Food - Salt Lake City, Utah

freeform.us.title: Enchanted
freeform.us.description: Banished by an evil queen, Princess Giselle (Amy Adams) from a fairy-tale world lands in modern Manhattan, where music, magic and "happily ever after" are sorely lacking. She is adrift in this strange new place until a divorce lawyer (Patrick Dempsey) comes to her aid. Giselle begins to fall for her flawed benefactor, but the storybook romance gets complicated when a prince from her world comes to rescue her. (Children, Fantasy, Romantic comedy, Musical, Animated) - 2007

freeform.us.title: Freaky Friday
freeform.us.description: Single mother Tess Coleman (Jamie Lee Curtis) and her teenage daughter Anna (Lindsay Lohan) couldn't be more different, and it is driving them both insane. After receiving cryptic fortunes at a Chinese restaurant, the two wake up the next day to discover that they have somehow switched bodies. Unable to switch back, they are forced to masquerade as one another until a solution can be found. In the process, they develop a new sense of respect and understanding for one another. (Family, Comedy, Fantasy) - 2003

freeform.us.title: The Parent Trap
freeform.us.description: Twins Annie and Hallie are strangers until happenstance unites them. The preteen girls' divorced parents, Nick and Elizabeth are living on opposite sides of the Atlantic, each with one child. After meeting at camp, American Hallie and British-raised Annie engineer an identity swap, giving both the chance to spend time with the parent they've missed. If the scheme works, it might just make the family whole again. (Children, Comedy) - 1998

freeform.us.title: The Incredibles
freeform.us.description: In this lauded Pixar animated film, married superheroes Mr. Incredible (Craig T. Nelson) and Elastigirl (Holly Hunter) are forced to assume mundane lives as Bob and Helen Parr after all super-powered activities have been banned by the government. While Mr. Incredible loves his wife and kids, he longs to return to a life of adventure, and he gets a chance when summoned to an island to battle an out-of-control robot. Soon, Mr. Incredible is in trouble, and it's up to his family to save him. (Animated, Children, Comedy, Adventure) - 2004

freeform.us.title: Incredibles 2
freeform.us.description: Telecommunications guru Winston Deavor enlists Elastigirl to fight crime and make the public fall in love with superheroes once again. That leaves Mr. Incredible with one of his greatest challenges ever -- staying home and taking care of three rambunctious children. As Violet, Dash and Jack-Jack offer him a new set of headaches, a cybercriminal named Screenslaver launches his dastardly plan -- hypnotizing the world through computer screens. (Animated, Children, Comedy, Adventure, Action) - 2018

fx.us.title: Thor

As punishment, Odin banishes Thor to Earth. While Loki (Tom Hiddleston), Thor's brother, plots mischief in Asgard, Thor, now stripped of his powers, faces his greatest threat. (Action, Adventure, Fantasy) - 2011

fx.us.title: Thor: The Dark World

The survivors were neutralized, and their ultimate weapon -- the Aether -- was buried in a secret location. Hundreds of years later, Jane Foster (Natalie Portman) finds the Aether and becomes its host, forcing Thor (Chris Hemsworth) to bring her to Asgard before Dark Elf Malekith (Christopher Eccleston) captures her and uses the weapon to destroy the Nine Realms -- including Earth. (Action, Adventure, Fantasy) - 2013

fx.us.title: This Means War

FDR and Tuck both fall hard for the beautiful blonde, turning their deadly skills and an array of high-tech gadgetry against each other in an all-out battle for her love. (Action, Comedy) - 2012

(Drama) - 1961

Marcus and Jacqueline become involved, but he is put off by her noncommittal approach to their relationship. Meanwhile, Marcus also begins to develop feelings for the pretty Angela (Halle Berry), who is more thoughtful than Jacqueline. (Romantic comedy) - 1992

Under the leadership of Spartacus, they make their way to southern Italy, where they will cross the sea and return to their homes. (Historical drama, Action) - 1960

Eddie sets out to woo Miranda and extricate himself from his wife's claws. (Comedy, Romance) - 2007

mgmplushits.us.title: Good Boy!

Now, the Greater Dane (Vanessa Redgrave) wants a report on the takeover, so she sends Hubble (Matthew Broderick) to investigate. When he's adopted by the lonely Owen (Liam Aiken), Hubble slowly realizes that dogs have forgotten their mission. They're not man's worst enemy -- they're his best friend. And, to make matters worse, the Greater Dane is headed to Earth for an inspection. (Comedy, Fantasy) - 2003

mgmplushits.us.title: The Spiderwick Chronicles
mgmplushits.us.description: Of the three Grace children, Jared has always been thought of as the troublemaker. So when strange things happen after his family's move to a relative's dilapidated estate, sister Mallory, twin brother Simon and their mother assume that Jared is behind it all. However, magical creatures roam the grounds, and they all want a special book that Jared has found: a field guide to fantastic creatures, penned by Arthur Spiderwick. (Children, Fantasy, Adventure, Drama, Action) - 2008

mgmplushits.us.title: Sherlock Gnomes
mgmplushits.us.description: When Gnomeo and Juliet first arrive in London with their friends and family, their biggest concern is getting a new garden ready for spring. When everyone in the garden suddenly goes missing -- there's only one gnome to call -- Sherlock Gnomes. The famous detective and sworn protector of the city shows up with his sidekick Watson to investigate the case. The mystery soon leads the gnomes on a rollicking adventure as they meet all-new ornaments and explore an undiscovered side of London. (Animated, Children, Comedy, Adventure, Mystery) - 2018

mgmplushits.us.title: A Dog's Purpose

Reincarnated as multiple canines over the course of five decades, the lovable pooch develops an unbreakable bond with a kindred spirit named Ethan. As the boy grows older and comes to a crossroad, the dog once again comes back into his life to remind him of his true self. (Comedy drama, Fantasy) - 2017

mgmplushits.us.title: Teen Wolf

Fox) learns from his father, Harold (James Hampton), that being a werewolf runs in the family, he decides to take advantage of his freakish trait. With his newfound strength and agility, Scott quickly becomes the hero of his school's basketball team while winning over longtime crush Pamela Wells (Lorie Griffin). As he grows more popular, Scott worries he is being celebrated as a novelty rather than for who he is. (Comedy, Fantasy) - 1985

mgmplushits.us.title: Teen Wolf Too

Luckily for Todd, he has inherited the same family curse that once turned his cousin into a werewolf. They take the entire family hostage -- but midnight comes and goes without a delivery. As their stay extends from hours into days, homeowner Dan Hilliard (Fredric March) complies with the felons' no-police demands to protect his wife and two children, while trying to plot an escape from the desperate situation. (Crime drama) - 1955

mgmplushits.us.title: Suburbicon
mgmplushits.us.description: Suburbicon is a peaceful, idyllic, suburban community with affordable homes and manicured lawns -- the perfect place to raise a family, and in the summer of 1959, the Lodge family is doing just that. But the tranquil surface masks a disturbing reality, as husband and father Gardner Lodge must navigate the town's dark underbelly of betrayal, deceit and violence. (Dark comedy, Thriller, Crime drama, Mystery) - 2017

When Quigley meets his employer, Elliott Marston (Alan Rickman), he's appalled to discover the job involves killing Aboriginal Australians. The two men fight, and when Quigley is knocked out, Marston leaves him and a local crazy woman (Laura San Giacomo) to die in a remote part of the Outback. They're rescued, however, and plot their revenge. (Western) - 1990

Gallagher's new job is to shepherd detainee Thomas Boyette (Tommy Lee Jones) from Europe to the U.S. But when Gallagher loses track of his prisoner, he asks his ex-wife, a servicewoman with access to Boyette's background data, for help. As the chase leads Gallagher to Chicago, the intrigue ramps up in a way he couldn't have imagined. (Thriller) - 1989

mgmplushits.us.title: The Score
mgmplushits.us.description: Career thief Nick Wells (Robert De Niro) is about to mastermind a nearly impossible theft that will require his joining forces with a clever young accomplice (Edward Norton). The unlikely alliance, arranged by Nick's longtime friend and fence, Max (Marlon Brando), interrupts Nick's plan to retire from crime and settle down with his fiancée, Diane (Angela Bassett). Worse, it requires that Nick violate his most important rule: Always work alone. (Thriller, Crime drama, Action) - 2001

mgmplushits.us.title: Platoon
mgmplushits.us.description: Chris Taylor (Charlie Sheen) leaves his university studies to enlist in combat duty in Vietnam in 1967. Once he's on the ground in the middle of battle, his idealism fades. Infighting in his unit between Staff Sergeant Barnes (Tom Berenger), who believes nearby villagers are harboring Viet Cong soldiers, and Sergeant Elias (Willem Dafoe), who has a more sympathetic view of the locals, ends up pitting the soldiers against each other as well as against the enemy. (War, Drama) - 1986

mgmplushits.us.title: Valkyrie
mgmplushits.us.description: Fearing that Hitler will destroy his beloved Germany, Col. Claus von Stauffenberg joins a group of high-ranking men who are plotting to assassinate him. - 2008

mgmplushits.us.title: Treasure Island - Chapter 5: Skeleton Island
mgmplushits.us.description: On Skeleton Island, Jim leads the search for the treasure as tension and paranoia rise when the island's dark history emerges; jockeying for control, they finally reach the fortune—but an unexpected force intervenes before anyone can claim it.

mgmplushits.us.title: The Institute - The Reckoning
mgmplushits.us.description: After their escape, Luke and friends plot to end the Institute for good; the Director enlists a new ally; Sigsby seeks a way back in.

mgmplushits.us.title: U-571
mgmplushits.us.description: American servicemen sneak aboard a disabled German sub to steal an encryption device they hope will help the Allies win the war. - 2000

mgmplushits.us.title: We Were Soldiers
mgmplushits.us.description: A lieutenant colonel and approximately 400 U.S. troops battle 2,000 North Vietnamese soldiers in 1965. - 2002

mgmplushits.us.title: Better Man
mgmplushits.us.description: The true story of the meteoric rise, dramatic fall, and remarkable resurgence of British pop superstar Robbie Williams. - 2024

mgmplushits.us.title: The Sons of Katie Elder
mgmplushits.us.description: Four sons learn their father gambled away the family ranch, leading to his murder. The brothers decide to avenge their father's death and win back the ranch, starting a feud with the local sheriff and the rival Hastings clan. - 1965

mgmplushits.us.title: The Great Gatsby
mgmplushits.us.description: A shady millionaire (Robert Redford) pines for another man's wife (Mia Farrow) amid the lavish parties and opulent mansions of 1920s Long Island. - 1974

mgmplushits.us.title: 2 Days in the Valley
mgmplushits.us.description: A hit man (Danny Aiello) falls for an art dealer's helper (Glenne Headly) amid confusion in the San Fernando Valley. - 1996

mgmplushits.us.title: Lenny
mgmplushits.us.description: 1950s comic Lenny Bruce (Dustin Hoffman) spurs controversy with his drug use, graphic language and marriage to a stripper (Valerie Perrine). - 1974

mgmplusmarquee.us.title: The Uninvited
mgmplusmarquee.us.description: After spending time in a psychiatric facility, young Anna (Emily Browning) finds significant changes in store at home. Her widowed father (David Strathairn) is now engaged to her mother's former nurse, Rachel (Elizabeth Banks). One night, the ghost of Anna's mother appears, screaming for revenge and accusing Rachel of murder. Anna and her sister, Alex (Arielle Kebbel), start to investigate, but they may be unprepared for the lethal battle of wills that ensues. (Horror, Thriller, Drama, Fantasy, Mystery) - 2009

mgmplusmarquee.us.title: A Quiet Place
mgmplusmarquee.us.description: If they hear you, they hunt you. A family must live in silence to avoid mysterious creatures that hunt by sound. Knowing that even the slightest whisper or footstep can bring death, Evelyn and Lee are determined to find a way to protect their children while desperately searching for a way to fight back. (Horror, Science fiction, Thriller) - 2018

mgmplusmarquee.us.title: Annihilation
mgmplusmarquee.us.description: Lena, a biologist and former soldier, joins a mission to uncover what happened to her husband inside Area X -- a sinister and mysterious phenomenon that is expanding across the American coastline. Once inside, the expedition discovers a world of mutated landscapes and creatures, as dangerous as it is beautiful, that threatens both their lives and their sanity. (Science fiction, Adventure, Thriller) - 2018

mgmplusmarquee.us.title: The Domestics
mgmplusmarquee.us.description: In a terrifying post-apocalyptic world inhabited by murderous gangs divided into deadly factions, Nina and Mark race desperately across the lawless countryside in search of safety. As one depraved group narrows their search for the couple, they must work together as they are pushed to the breaking point to survive. (Action, Thriller) - 2018

mgmplusmarquee.us.title: Disturbing Behavior
mgmplusmarquee.us.description: Steve Clark (James Marsden) is a newcomer in the town of Cradle Bay, and he quickly realizes that there's something odd about his high school classmates. The clique known as the Blue Ribbons are the eerie embodiment of academic excellence and clean living. But, like the rest of the town, they're a little too perfect. When Steve's rebellious friend Gavin (Nick Stahl) mysteriously joins their ranks, Steve searches for the truth with fellow misfit Rachel (Katie Holmes). (Horror, Mystery, Science fiction) - 1998

mgmplusmarquee.us.title: Stigmata
mgmplusmarquee.us.description: A young woman with no strong religious beliefs, Frankie Paige (Patricia Arquette) begins having strange and violent experiences, showing signs of the wounds that Jesus received when crucified. When the Vatican gets word of Frankie's situation, a high-ranking cardinal (Jonathan Pryce) requests that the Rev. Andrew Kiernan (Gabriel Byrne) investigate her case. Soon Kiernan realizes that very sinister forces are at work, and tries to rescue Frankie from the entity that is plaguing her. (Thriller) - 1999

mgmplusmarquee.us.title: Cold Storage
mgmplusmarquee.us.description: Two employees at a self-storage company have the wildest shift of their lives when a parasitic fungus that was sealed by the government escapes. As the temperature rises underground, the highly contagious and rapidly mutating microorganism starts to multiply as it unleashes its brain-controlling, body-bursting terrors on the facility's inhabitants -- human and otherwise. (Horror, Science fiction, Comedy) - 2026

mgmplusmarquee.us.title: Lockbox
mgmplusmarquee.us.description: Seeking peace after her mother's death, Ellen retreats to a rural town and takes in her severely traumatized cousin, Winthrop. Their fragile domestic balance soon shatters when an erratic neighbor warns her that Winthrop is dangerous. As strange phenomena start to escalate, Ellen must put everything on the line to defend Winthrop from a dangerous, otherworldly entity that's determined to track him down. (Horror, Thriller) - 2026

mgmplusmarquee.us.title: Red Eye
mgmplusmarquee.us.description: In the wake of her grandmother's funeral, hotel manager Lisa Reisert is waiting to fly back home when she meets charming Jackson Rippner at check-in. She thinks it luck that they're seated together on the plane, but soon learns otherwise. Jackson hopes to assassinate the head of Homeland Security, but to do so, he needs Lisa to reassign the official's room number at her hotel. As insurance, Jackson has kidnapped Lisa's father. (Thriller, Action, Drama, Mystery) - 2005

mgmplusmarquee.us.title: Stigmata

Soon Kiernan realizes that very sinister forces are at work, and tries to rescue Frankie from the entity that is plaguing her. (Thriller) - 1999

mgmplusmarquee.us.title: The Little Girl Who Lives Down the Lane
mgmplusmarquee.us.description: Quiet, withdrawn 13-year-old Rynn Jacobs (Jodie Foster) lives peacefully in her home in a New England beach town. Whenever the prying landlady (Alexis Smith) inquires after Rynn's father, she politely claims that he's in the city on business. But when the landlady's creepy and increasingly persistent son, Frank (Martin Sheen), won't leave Rynn alone, she teams up with kindly neighbor boy Mario (Scott Jacoby) to maintain the dark family secret that she's been keeping to herself. (Thriller) - 1976

mgmplusmarquee.us.title: The Texas Chainsaw Massacre Part 2
mgmplusmarquee.us.description: Chainsaw-wielding maniac Leatherface (Bill Johnson) is up to his cannibalistic ways once again, along with the rest of his twisted clan, including the equally disturbed Chop-Top (Bill Moseley). This time, the masked killer has set his sights on pretty disc jockey Vanita Stretch Brock (Caroline Williams), who teams up with Texas lawman Lefty Enright (Dennis Hopper) to battle the psychopath and his family deep within their lair, a macabre abandoned amusement park. (Horror, Dark comedy) - 1986

mgmplusmarquee.us.title: The Black Stallion
mgmplusmarquee.us.description: Alec (Kelly Reno) encounters a magnificent black Arabian horse while traveling aboard a steamship around the coast of North Africa with his father (Hoyt Axton). When a disaster destroys the ship, Alec frees the horse and escapes with it to a nearby island, where they form a close bond. When Alec is rescued, he insists the horse be rescued too, and both return to America. There, Alec and former jockey Henry (Mickey Rooney) work to train the horse, which Alec names The Black, for a race. (Children, Adventure) - 1979

mgmplusmarquee.us.title: Boo 2! A Madea Halloween
mgmplusmarquee.us.description: Tiffany travels to Derrick Lake to celebrate her 18th birthday at a Halloween frat party in the middle of the woods. Frantic and worried, Madea, Aunt Bam and Hattie hop in the car to save her from the same terrible fate that befell a group of teens there years earlier. Chaos soon strikes when the would-be heroes find themselves fighting for their lives against an array of spooky monsters, goblins and boogeymen. (Holiday, Comedy, Adventure) - 2017

mgmplusmarquee.us.title: Scouts Guide to the Zombie Apocalypse
mgmplusmarquee.us.description: What could possibly go wrong when three buddies (Tye Sheridan, Logan Miller, Joey Morgan) decide to join the Boy Scouts? When bloodthirsty, undead ghouls invade their once-peaceful town, it's up to kindhearted Ben, quick-witted Carter and class clown Augie to save the day. With help from Denise (Sarah Dumont), a beautiful but tough cocktail waitress, the boys must put their scouting skills to the ultimate test to save mankind and earn their zombie-killing badges. (Horror, Comedy) - 2015

mgmplusmarquee.us.title: Some Kind of Wonderful
mgmplusmarquee.us.description: Keith Nelson (Eric Stoltz), an artsy high school outcast, tries to land a date with popular girl Amanda Jones (Lea Thompson) with some help from his tomboy best friend, Watts (Mary Stuart Masterson). However, his advances draw the ire of Amanda's snobby ex-boyfriend, Hardy Jenns (Craig Sheffer), who makes plans to get even. Matters are further complicated when Watts realizes she likes Keith as more than just a friend and tries to convince him to stop pursuing Amanda. (Romance, Drama) - 1987

mgmplusmarquee.us.title: Return to Me
mgmplusmarquee.us.description: A heart-transplant recipient (Minnie Driver) meets the donor's lonely widower (David Duchovny) in a chance encounter. - 2000

mgmplusmarquee.us.title: Moonstruck
mgmplusmarquee.us.description: An Italian-American widow (Cher), engaged to a reticent suitor, falls in love with his brother (Nicolas Cage). - 1987

mgmplusmarquee.us.title: An Officer and a Gentleman
mgmplusmarquee.us.description: A hardened loner (Richard Gere) shapes up for a military drill instructor (Louis Gossett Jr.) and a factory girl (Debra Winger) from town. - 1982

mgmplusmarquee.us.title: Children of a Lesser God
mgmplusmarquee.us.description: Starting his new job as an instructor at a New England school for the deaf, James Leeds meets Sarah Norman, a young deaf woman who works at the school as a member of the custodial staff. - 1986

mgmplusmarquee.us.title: The Man in the Moon
mgmplusmarquee.us.description: A couple's (Sam Waterston, Tess Harper) two daughters catch the eye of their new teenage neighbor in 1957 Louisiana. - 1991

mgmplusmarquee.us.title: The Professionals
mgmplusmarquee.us.description: A circa-1917 rancher sends mercenaries (Lee Marvin, Burt Lancaster) to rescue his kidnapped wife (Claudia Cardinale) from a Mexican bandit. - 1966

mgmplusmarquee.us.title: Sherlock Gnomes
mgmplusmarquee.us.description: When Gnomeo and Juliet first arrive in London, their biggest concern is getting their new garden ready for spring. After someone kidnaps their garden gnomes, the duo calls on famous Detective Sherlock Gnomes and his sidekick Watson to solve the case. - 2018

mlbnetwork.us.title: Hot Stove ᴸᶦᵛᵉ
mlbnetwork.us.description: Baby, it might be cold outside, and the springtime sounds of bats hitting balls are months away. What better way for baseball fans to cure the winter blues than to gather around the "Hot Stove" and warm up to the news of the offseason? MLB Network has all the angles covered for all 30 teams, from trades and free agent signings to the juicy rumors that percolate throughout, especially at the annual Winter Meetings in December. A host of former players, including Joe Magrane, Al Leiter, Sean Casey and Dan Plesac, analyze the news, supplemented by insider information from journalists Jon Heyman, Tom Verducci and Peter Gammons, among others. (Sports talk, Baseball) - 2009-01-01

mtv2west.us.title: Ridiculousness - Rob Riggle
mtv2west.us.description: Comic Rob Riggle joins Rob, Steelo, and Chanel as they visit a "Ski Disaster Academy," celebrate some "North American Turds" and report the news while "Live on the Scene."

mtv2west.us.title: Ridiculousness - Terrence J
mtv2west.us.description: Terrence J, host of MTV's "Safeword" and "Are You the One," joins Rob, Steelo and Chanel to meet some "Broken Dogs," check out some "Fly Kicks" and swipe left on some folks who are "Definitely..."

mtv2west.us.title: Ridiculousness - Jasper & Errol
mtv2west.us.description: Jasper and Errol join the crew to see who "Can't Feel the Heat," get in time with some "Synchronized Suckers," and greet some "Polite Fighters."

mtv2west.us.title: Ridiculousness - Cody Garbrandt
mtv2west.us.description: UFC champ Cody Garbrandt joins Rob, Chanel and Steelo to take a ride on the "Heckle Highway"; doing some hard time with "Best Felons Forever"; enjoying some good old-fashioned street fighting.

mtv2west.us.title: Ridiculousness - Jamie Bestwick
mtv2west.us.description: BMXer Jamie Bestwick; "Vert Hurt"; "Youth Slayers"; "Rothrocked."

mtv2west.us.title: Ridiculousness - Steve Wilkos
mtv2west.us.description: Steve Wilkos; "Surprise T..."; "Stevecurity"; "Highest Rated Category Ever."

mtv2west.us.title: Ridiculousness - Wheeler Walker, Jr.
mtv2west.us.description: Wheeler Walker, Jr.; "Banned Mates"; "Muff Maintenance."

mtv2west.us.title: Ridiculousness - Sam Sadler
mtv2west.us.description: YouTuber Sam Sadler; "Pins and Needles"; "Scared Forever."

mtv2west.us.title: Ridiculousness - Lewis Howes
mtv2west.us.description: Motivational guru Lewis Howes joins Rob, Chanel and Steelo to talk about "The School of Wackness," motivators who are nothing more than "Halfway Howes," and the fear known as "Asnakenophobia."

mtv2west.us.title: Ridiculousness - Hampton Yount
mtv2west.us.description: Comic Hampton Yount; "Risky Bits"; "Next Level Narrators"; "Hamspired."

mtv2west.us.title: Ridiculousness - Laurie Hernandez
mtv2west.us.description: Gymnastics champion Laurie Hernandez joins Rob, Chanel and Steelo to talk about her finely tuned "Slamdar," and the difference between her and "Street Gymnasts."

mtv2west.us.title: Ridiculousness - Metta World Peace
mtv2west.us.description: Metta World Peace; "Metta Ball"; "Here for the Discount."

mtv2west.us.title: The Jamie Foxx Show - Scareder Than a Mug
mtv2west.us.description: Helen (Ellia English) ends up in therapy after an encounter with a mugger.

mtv2west.us.title: The Jamie Foxx Show - Forever Your Girl
mtv2west.us.description: Jamie (Jamie Foxx) jumps to the service of a beautiful hotel guest (guest star Angelle Brooks); Junior and Helen (Garrett Morris, Ellia English) buy a karaoke player.

mtv2west.us.title: The Jamie Foxx Show - Where There's a Will, Go the Other Way
mtv2west.us.description: Braxton and Fancy (Christopher B. Duncan, Garcelle Beauvais) get raises, leaving Jamie (Jamie Foxx) feeling slighted.

mtv2west.us.title: The Jamie Foxx Show - Uncle Junior's Cabin
mtv2west.us.description: Junior and Helen offer a free getaway, but a weekend together doesn't appeal to Jamie, Fancy and Braxton.

mtv2west.us.title: The Wayans Bros. - The Rich Girl
mtv2west.us.description: Shawn (Shawn Wayans) worries that Pops (John Witherspoon) will embarrass him when he meets his rich girlfriend's father (guest star Tucker Smallwood).

mtv2west.us.title: The Wayans Bros. - Busta Saves the Day
mtv2west.us.description: Rapper Busta Rhymes (as himself) saves the day after Marlon and Shawn (Marlon Wayans, Shawn Wayans) lose money for Dee's (Anna Maria Horsford) church benefit.

mtv2west.us.title: The Wayans Bros. - Talk Is Cheap
mtv2west.us.description: Shawn and Marlon (Shawn Wayans, Marlon Wayans) go on "The Jerry Springer Show" and end up battling over Marlon's girlfriend (guest star Adriane Kelly). Jerry Springer also guest stars.

mtv2west.us.title: The Wayans Bros. - Bringing It All Back Home
mtv2west.us.description: Shawn and Marlon (Shawn Wayans, Marlon Wayans) plot to keep Pops (John Witherspoon) from selling the family home by making it less marketable.

mtv2west.us.title: The Wayans Bros. - Recipe for Success
mtv2west.us.description: Pops (John Witherspoon) shows off his chili at a food festival, but he doesn't know its secret ingredient: dog food.

mtv2west.us.title: The Wayans Bros. - Fire!
mtv2west.us.description: After Shawn (Shawn Wayans) is swindled by a business agent, Marlon (Marlon Wayans) takes an acting job to help his brother.

mtv2west.us.title: America's Funniest Home Videos - Thanksgiving, Selfies, and Dog Park
mtv2west.us.description: Gender reveal mishaps; kids astonished by magic tricks; a grown man who is very excited when he hears the neighborhood ice cream truck.

mtv2west.us.title: America's Funniest Home Videos - Gender Reveals, Magic Fails, and I Think I See the Problem
mtv2west.us.description: A woman who is grossed out by having to prepare a turkey for dinner; a little boy who is thankful for dinosaurs; selfies gone wrong; people get scared.

mtv2west.us.title: Help! I'm in a Secret Relationship! - Xan and Mandela
mtv2west.us.description: Mandela keeps Xan hidden during their relationship for a year and a half; she wants to marry him but is tired of being kept a secret.

mtv2west.us.title: Help! I'm in a Secret Relationship! - DaShaun & Aleeta
mtv2west.us.description: Young parents DaShaun and Aleeta have two sons; the stress of parenthood led to a short break but since being back together DaShaun has been cut off from Aleeta's family, and he needs to know why.

mtv2west.us.title: Help! I'm in a Secret Relationship! - Bryan & Elene
mtv2west.us.description: Travis Mills and Rahne Jones uncover stories of people who have been emotionally manipulated into secret relationships.

nationalgeographicwild.us.title: When Sharks Attack - Space Coast Scare ᴺᵉʷ
nationalgeographicwild.us.description: In 2003 along Florida's Space Coast, the power of rockets high above are rivalled by the terror of the depths down below. (Documentary, Nature, Animals) - 2022-07-13

nationalgeographicwild.us.title: Airport Security: Peru and Brazil - Busted Baggage ᴺᵉʷ
nationalgeographicwild.us.description: When agents at Jorge Chavez International Airport detain a man with drugs in his suitcase, he breaks down when speaking with his mother. Meanwhile, a woman may be carrying cocaine-contaminated olives. (Documentary, Crime) - 2020-05-07

nationalgeographicwild.us.title: Yukon Vet - Dr. O and the Three Bears ᴺᵉʷ
nationalgeographicwild.us.description: Dr. Oakley helps a dog that was attacked while protecting its owner and a guinea pig with raspy breathing. She also has a look at a lynx with deformed legs. (Reality, Animals, Medical) - 2021-04-17

nationalgeographicwild.us.title: Secrets of the Zoo: Tampa - Crash Landing ᴺᵉʷ
nationalgeographicwild.us.description: ZooTampa rolls out the red carpet for new arrivals, big and small. (Animals, Nature) - 2023-01-01

nationalgeographicwild.us.title: Land Of 10,000 Grizzlies ᴺᵉʷ
nationalgeographicwild.us.description: In the far east of Russia, a mountainous peninsula is home to volcanoes, geysers, and one of the world's largest populations of grizzly bears. (Special, Documentary, Animals) - 2015-07-13

nationalgeographicwild.us.title: Dragons Uncovered ᴺᵉʷ
nationalgeographicwild.us.description: The Komodo dragon has captured our imaginations for more than a century, but we are only now discovering some of its most wondrous secrets. (Special, Animals, Documentary) - 2024-10-27

nationalgeographicwild.us.title: Something Bit Me! - This Is Not a Deer! ᴺᵉʷ
nationalgeographicwild.us.description: A stay in the jungle of Costa Rica turns into a horror trip for the location scout of a production company. An encounter with an animal inhabitant of the jungle leads him into a nightmarish race. (Documentary, Nature, Animals) - 2022-02-27

nationalgeographicwild.us.title: Ice Road Rescue - Blizzard Showdown ᴺᵉʷ
nationalgeographicwild.us.description: Bjoern finds himself in a difficult situation when a double accident forces him to ask his rivals for help. On the other side of the mountain, Thord must rescue a 14-tonne tractor that threatens to tip over on top of prime real estate. (Reality, Travel, Nature, Outdoors) - 2022-11-03

nationalgeographicwild.us.title: Casey and Brutus: Grizzly Encounters - Project Kodiak ᴺᵉʷ
nationalgeographicwild.us.description: Casey immerses himself in grizzly life on Alaska's Kodiak Island, hoping for some top salmon fishing tips from the wild ones to take back to his captive bear Brutus. (Documentary, Animals) - 2010-08-25

nationalgeographicwild.us.title: Snakes in the City - Snakes & Ladders ᴺᵉʷ
nationalgeographicwild.us.description: Simon and Sioux continue to train their apprentice Mbali before heading to the snake capital of the world. It is monsoon season in the Indian city of Mysore and local snake catcher Snake Shyam needs help. (Reality, Animals, Documentary) - 2023-07-03

nationalgeographicwild.us.title: The Incredible Dr. Pol - Pol-tergeist ᴺᵉʷ
nationalgeographicwild.us.description: Halloween is coming, and Dr Pol is in his element dealing with jumping, flailing, and barking clientele. Charles has some tricks up his sleeves, but that's nothing compared to the surprises patients bring, as Dr Pol is hit with blood, pee, and a kick in the knee. The doc and family visit a haunted yard, but after dealing with an angry herd of beef cattle, a pair of ill-mannered sugar gliders, and a skittish stallion, Dr Pol ain't scared of no ghosts! (Holiday, Reality, Animals) - 2014-10-25

nationalgeographicwild.us.title: Yukon Vet - Like Mother, Like Daughter ᴺᵉʷ
nationalgeographicwild.us.description: Dr. Oakley performs a checkup on two scrappy lynx, and Sierra takes charge on clinic day. (Reality, Animals, Medical) - 2023-05-13

nationalgeographicwild.us.title: Life Below Zero: First Alaskans - Answer the Call ᴺᵉʷ
nationalgeographicwild.us.description: Alaska Natives train the next generation to provide from the land. (Reality, Documentary, Outdoors, Adventure) - 2023-05-30

nationalgeographicwild.us.title: Teleshopping
nationalgeographicwild.us.description: Presenting the latest products live on television that can be ordered directly. The product range extends from vacuum cleaners and bath towels to sports equipment. (Shopping, Consumer) - 2002-03-06

nationalgeographicwild.us.title: Bizarre Animal Friends - The Chihuahua and the Chicken ᴺᵉʷ
nationalgeographicwild.us.description: A two-legged Chihuahua and his chicken friend, a mountaineer and his rock-climbing cat, a goat that refuses to leave his donkey friend's side. (Documentary, Nature, Animals) - 2015-02-27

nationalgeographicwild.us.title: Critter Fixers: Country Vets - Barnyard Frenemies ᴺᵉʷ
nationalgeographicwild.us.description: A calf and squirrel are rescued; a cat gets its stomach untied; a donkey fight is fixed. (Animals, Pets, Reality) - 2021-05-22

nationalgeographicwild.us.title: Snakes in the City - Tunnel of Doom ᴺᵉʷ
nationalgeographicwild.us.description: Simon and Sioux mud wrestle a 12-foot black mamba trapped inside a storm water drain. A new homeowner has an unwanted visitor and Sioux gets dirty flushing out a forest cobra from a toilet. (Reality, Animals, Documentary) - 2018-10-05

nationalgeographicwild.us.title: Animals Gone Wild - Cheating Death ᴺᵉʷ
nationalgeographicwild.us.description: Looking at an elephant's run-in with a carload of tourists and closely examining a lion's instincts that cannot be tamed. Also, observing how a tiny dog instinctually takes on armed robbers. (Documentary, Animals) - 2015-04-20

nationalgeographicwild.us.title: Close Encounters of the Wild Kind - Into the Woods ᴺᵉʷ
nationalgeographicwild.us.description: If you go down to the woods today, be prepared for every kind of surprise. Take a hike into the wilderness to discover how to avoid a run-in with a bison and when to duck if you see a deer. (Documentary) - 2025-09-03

nationalgeographicwild.us.title: Heartland Docs, DVM - Thanks for the Mammaries ᴺᵉʷ
nationalgeographicwild.us.description: Dr. Erin finds herself in a messy situation with a goat; Dr. Ben helps a calf with an umbilical hernia. (Reality, Animals) - 2022-06-12

nationalgeographicwild.us.title: Dust ᴺᵉʷ
nationalgeographicwild.us.description: In Botswana, where the Okavango Delta fades into the Kalahari, water and desert clash in a yearly cycle of abundance and loss. Along Africa's longest zebra migration, herds, predators and desert. (Special, Documentary) - 2026-09-27

nationalgeographicwild.us.title: Europe From Above - Spanish Islands ᴺᵉʷ
nationalgeographicwild.us.description: A birds-eye view of the Canaries and Balearic Islands of Spain showcases astonishing marine mammals, and unique vineyards. A gothic Cathedral welcomes a rare light phenomenon. (Documentary, Travel) - 2023-06-21

nationalgeographicwild.us.title: When Sharks Attack - Twice Bitten ᴺᵉʷ
nationalgeographicwild.us.description: The odds of being bitten by a shark are around one in 17 million. But what about being bitten twice? Two unlucky oceans lovers endure not just one, but two terrifying shark encounters. (Documentary, Nature, Animals) - 2022-07-16

nationalgeographicwild.us.title: Airport Security: Peru and Brazil - Soaked In Cocaine ᴺᵉʷ
nationalgeographicwild.us.description: Agents at Jorge Chavez International Airport race to locate a suspect, who is hiding in a very surprising location. Later, an arrogant smuggler with a stuffed suitcase has double the expected load. (Documentary, Crime) - 2020-05-14

nationalgeographicwild.us.title: Yukon Vet - Lynx Be a Lady ᴺᵉʷ
nationalgeographicwild.us.description: Dr. Oakley diagnoses a mass on a horse, uncovers a surprise during a lynx's checkup, and treats a dachshund with a skin issue. (Reality, Animals, Medical) - 2021-05-01

nationalgeographicwild.us.title: Secrets of the Zoo: Tampa - Scent of a Porcupine ᴺᵉʷ
nationalgeographicwild.us.description: A clouded leopard mystery, two new giraffes and a growing binturong family. (Animals, Nature) - 2023-01-08

nationalgeographicwild.us.title: Secrets of the Bees - The Hive ᴺᵉʷ
nationalgeographicwild.us.description: National Geographic Explorer Bertie Gregory explores the extraordinary lives of bees - among the planet's most important animals. (Documentary) - 2026-04-01

nationalgeographicwild.us.title: Secrets of the Bees - The Pollinators ᴺᵉʷ
nationalgeographicwild.us.description: National Geographic Explorer Bertie Gregory returns to the honeybee sisterhood as they race to rebuild before winter. (Documentary) - 2026-04-01

nationalgeographicwild.us.title: Something Bit Me! - Where's Mom? ᴺᵉʷ
nationalgeographicwild.us.description: Two vastly different creatures. Two shocked humans. One agenda: survival. (Documentary, Nature, Animals) - 2022-03-27

nationalgeographicwild.us.title: Ice Road Rescue - Triple Jeopardy ᴺᵉʷ
nationalgeographicwild.us.description: In the north, Jo Roger's rookies are put to the test with the rescue of three vehicles that have fallen off the road. In the south, Thord and Andrzej must try to rescue a crashed bus in a race against time. (Reality, Travel, Nature, Outdoors) - 2022-11-10

nationalgeographicwild.us.title: Casey and Brutus: Grizzly Encounters - Inside the Wolf Pack ᴺᵉʷ
nationalgeographicwild.us.description: Casey examines the controversial wolf reintroduction at Yellowstone Park and ventures 'inside the pack' to create an intriguing profile of the park's apex predator.

nationalgeographicwild.us.title: Snakes in the City - Mamba Invasion ᴺᵉʷ
nationalgeographicwild.us.description: A massive 2.5 metre black mamba is holding a flat block hostage, meanwhile Sioux uncovers another one at a wedding venue, and this time she must catch it alone. The crew get called to another big grey snake that turns out to be a turtle.

nationalgeographicwild.us.title: The Incredible Dr. Pol - Santa Paws ᴺᵉʷ
nationalgeographicwild.us.description: Dr Pol headed to John Jordan's for his first farm call of the day. Meanwhile, Dr Brenda races out to Rooftop Landing, where a reindeer named Ole is aching for a chance to pull Santa's sleigh.

nationalgeographicwild.us.title: Yukon Vet - Just Another Manic Meatball ᴺᵉʷ
nationalgeographicwild.us.description: Back in the Yukon, the Oakleys keep over 100 cattle and a rowdy mini mule.

nationalgeographicwild.us.title: Life Below Zero: First Alaskans - Homelands ᴺᵉʷ
nationalgeographicwild.us.description: Alaskan Native families carry on their traditional ways on their homelands.

nationalgeographicwild.us.title: Teleshopping
nationalgeographicwild.us.description: Presenting the latest products live on television that can be ordered directly. The product range extends from vacuum cleaners and bath towels to sports equipment.

nationalgeographicwild.us.title: Bizarre Animal Friends - The Tale of the Cockatoo and the Kitty Cat ᴺᵉʷ
nationalgeographicwild.us.description: A cockatoo enjoys giving massages to her once-feral feline friend, a California man takes a goat surfing, and a dog befriends an eagle owl.

nationalgeographicwild.us.title: Critter Fixers: Country Vets - Titan's Hero ᴺᵉʷ
nationalgeographicwild.us.description: The Critter Fixers call an unexpected hero to save a sick puppy named Titan.

nationalgeographicwild.us.title: Snakes in the City - Hiss The Night ᴺᵉʷ
nationalgeographicwild.us.description: Snake City is hammered by summer storms as Simon and Siouxsie hunt for a black mamba in a pile of tiles by torchlight. When the skies clear, Sioux gets tangled up in a deadly game of tug-of-war with a feisty forest cobra.

nationalgeographicwild.us.title: Animals Gone Wild - The Bold And The Brutal ᴺᵉʷ
nationalgeographicwild.us.description: A pair of giraffes battle viciously for dominance, a fisherman is caught by feeding alligators, and a buffalo tosses a lion like a rag doll.

nationalgeographicwild.us.title: Close Encounters of the Wild Kind - Urban Jungle ᴺᵉʷ
nationalgeographicwild.us.description: Soon two-thirds of the global population will be living in cities, leaving wild animals to develop a whole new set of street smarts, such as a hungry bear raiding a supermarket, or a raccoon figuring out how to open a wildlife-proof bin.

nationalgeographicwild.us.title: Heartland Docs, DVM - Pro Bone-O Work ᴺᵉʷ

nflnetwork.us.description: NFL Network enters the morning show fray with a three-hour live presentation. Each day, "Good Morning Football" brings viewers up-to-the-minute breaking NFL news and local NFL stories on a national platform. The show features a combination of headline-making interviews and a discussion of a wide array of issues in the areas of sports, news and entertainment. By booking celebrity guests and opinionated national and local journalists -- and taking advantage of a close collaboration with all 32 NFL franchises -- "Good Morning Football" breaks out within and well beyond its time period. screenpix.us.title: Thunder Road
screenpix.us.description: Unrepentant Tennessee moonshine runner Luke Doolin (Robert Mitchum) makes dangerous high-speed deliveries for his liquor-producing father, Vernon (Trevor Bardette), but won't let his younger brother Robin (James Mitchum) join the family business. Under pressure from both out-of-town gangster Kogan (Jacques Aubuchon), who wants a piece of the local action, and Treasury agent Barrett (Gene Barry), who wants to destroy the moonshine business, Luke fights for his fast-fading way of life. (Adventure, Drama, Action) - 1958

screenpix.us.title: The Organization
screenpix.us.description: When an executive and a night watchman are killed in a San Francisco office building, Lt. Virgil Tibbs is called in to investigate and discovers the watchman was actually killed elsewhere. Soon Tibbs is contacted by urban revolutionaries who confess to kidnapping -- but not killing -- the watchman in a botched attempt to expose a heroin ring operating out of the building. Tibbs believes them, but when his superiors learn of his ties to the group, he's suspended from the force. (Action, Crime drama, Thriller) - 1971

screenpix.us.title: Behind the Mask
screenpix.us.description: The Shadow (Kane Richmond) tracks a killer to a clip joint and exposes a city editor's racket. (Crime drama) - 1946

screenpix.us.title: The Mini-Skirt Mob
screenpix.us.description: The leader (Diane McBain) of a motorcycle gang harasses her ex-boyfriend and his bride (Sherry Jackson) on their highway honeymoon. (Action) - 1968

screenpix.us.title: The Big Caper
screenpix.us.description: A crook's (James Gregory) partners (Rory Calhoun, Mary Costa) pose as newlyweds near Camp Pendleton, Calif., to set up a Marine payroll heist. (Crime drama) - 1957

screenpix.us.title: Kings Go Forth
screenpix.us.description: During World War II, in a picturesque town on the French Riviera, U.S. Army Lt. Sam Loggins (Frank Sinatra) and Cpl. Britt Harris (Tony Curtis) both fall for the same local girl, the American-born Monique Blair (Natalie Wood). But when the soldiers learn that Monique and her mother (Leora Dana) had moved to France from the United States to escape discrimination against her parents' interracial marriage, each man must examine his own bigotry and prejudices. (War, Drama) - 1958

screenpix.us.title: Marshal Law

screenpix.us.title: Warriors Five
screenpix.us.description: An American paratrooper (Jack Palance), aided by group of Italian guerrillas, starts a delaying action against the Germans. (War, Historical drama) - 1962

screenpix.us.title: The Wild Angels
screenpix.us.description: When Hell's Angels member Loser (Bruce Dern) has his motorcycle swiped, he entreats his gang to help him seek the bike, and revenge. Gang leader Heavenly Blues (Peter Fonda) and his lady, Mike (Nancy Sinatra), succeed in tracking down the thieves, but when a fracas breaks out between the gangs, the cops shoot Loser, putting him in the hospital. The rest of the Angels try to rescue Loser from his sickbed, wreaking havoc in the ward and doing their buddy more harm than good. (Action) - 1966

screenpix.us.title: Four Boys and a Gun

screenpix.us.title: The Black Sleep

screenpix.us.title: The Belly of an Architect
screenpix.us.description: Stourley Kracklite (Brian Dennehy), a driven, detail-obsessed architect, travels from America to Rome with his much younger wife, Louisa (Chloe Webb), to oversee an architectural homage to a personal hero, 18th-century master builder Etienne-Louis Boullée. En route by train, Stourley and Louisa conceive a much-wanted child -- but Stourley's obsession with his wife's expanding belly, her perceived infidelity, and his own recurrent bouts of abdominal pain reach epic and dangerous proportions. (Comedy drama) - 1987

screenpix.us.title: Lord Love a Duck
screenpix.us.description: An unusually gifted high school senior, Alan Musgrave (Roddy McDowall), decides to direct his mental powers toward helping an innocent new student, Barbara Ann Greene (Tuesday Weld), achieve her goal of popularity. With Alan's guidance, Barbara climbs the social ladder, finds a husband and eventually gets a shot at a glamorous movie career. But when Barbara's husband begins to get in the way of her ambitions, Alan will stop at nothing to make sure she reaches the top. (Comedy) - 1966

screenpixaction.us.title: Midnight Heat
screenpixaction.us.description: Banker John Gray (Brian Bosworth) is hit by a car, and he awakens days later having lost his memory. He goes through the motions of his plush Arizona lifestyle but keeps having momentary visions of a violent past and a sinister figure he identifies as Thomas Payne (Brad Dourif). After his wife, whom he barely knows, is killed, Gray travels to Los Angeles and explores the criminal underworld, hoping to discover the truth about his identity -- and to confront Payne. (Action) - 1996

screenpixaction.us.title: Ordeal by Innocence
screenpixaction.us.description: A 1950s U.S. scientist (Donald Sutherland) probes the murder of a British friend's (Christopher Plummer) wife (Faye Dunaway). (Mystery) - 1984

screenpixaction.us.title: The Limbic Region
screenpixaction.us.description: In San Francisco in the 1970s, a serial killer calling himself The Scorekeeper sends taunting notes to the police and media after each of his kills. Although the case is long closed, obsessed detective Jon Lucca (Edward James Olmos) still suspects the wrong man was named as the killer. Learning he has only weeks to live, Lucca meets with Lloyd Ward (George Dzundza) -- the man he has long been convinced is the murderer, but never had enough evidence to arrest -- intending to force a confession. (Thriller) - 1996

screenpixaction.us.title: The Bride Wore Black
screenpixaction.us.description: After newly widowed Julie Kohler's mother stops her from committing suicide, she hatches a different plan to deal with her grief. In a small black book, she lists five men. One by one she visits the men with murderous intentions, assuming different identities to get close to them. Only one man remains elusive, having been captured by the cops before Julie could reach him -- but despite the obstacles, Julie intends to see her task through to the end. (Thriller) - 1968

screenpixaction.us.title: House of 1,000 Dolls
screenpixaction.us.description: A magician (Vincent Price) and his assistant (Martha Hyer) lure women from the audience into white slavery in Tangier. (Drama) - 1967

screenpixaction.us.title: Hannibal Brooks
screenpixaction.us.description: A British prisoner of war is assigned to take care of an elephant in a zoo. Along with an American and an Austrian he escapes with the elephant and heads for the Swiss border. They use the elephant to gain access across the border. A Polish girl betrays them and aligns herself with the Nazis. (Comedy drama, War) - 1969

screenpixaction.us.title: The Russians Are Coming, the Russians Are Coming
screenpixaction.us.description: When a Soviet submarine gets stuck on a sandbar off the coast of a New England island, its commander (Theodore Bikel) orders his second-in-command, Lieutenant Rozanov (Alan Arkin), to get them moving again before there is an international incident. Rozanov seeks assistance from the island locals, including the police chief (Brian Keith) and a vacationing television writer (Carl Reiner), while trying to allay their fears of a Communist invasion by claiming he and his crew are Norwegian sailors. (Comedy) - 1966

screenpixaction.us.title: War, Italian Style

screenpixaction.us.title: The Square Peg

screenpixaction.us.title: Matchless

screenpixaction.us.title: Dr. Goldfoot and the Bikini Machine
screenpixaction.us.description: The dastardly Dr. Goldfoot (Vincent Price) and his sidekick, Igor (Jack Mullaney), build a race of bikini-wearing beauties who are designed to win the hearts and fortunes of the most influential men of the world. Before long, the manufactured women begin to succeed, and Robot 11 (Susan Hart) is sent to coax multimillionaire Todd Armstrong (Dwayne Hickman) into handing over his wealth. Government spy Craig Gamble (Frankie Avalon) tracks down Robot 11, but even he isn't immune to her charms. (Science fiction) - 1965

screenpixaction.us.title: Dr. Goldfoot and the Girl Bombs

Fortunately for the citizens of the globe, suave secret agent Bill Dexter (Fabian) is out to foil Goldfoot's plans, which involve kidnapping a prominent American general (also Price) who bears a striking resemblance to Goldfoot. Also getting in on the antics is inept aspiring spy Franco (Franco Franchi). (Science fiction) - 1966

screenpixaction.us.title: The Charge of the Light Brigade

An inept chain of command and the arrogance of the aristocratic officers nearly destroys the brigade. screenpixvoices.us.title: Penitentiary II
screenpixvoices.us.description: Boxer "Too Sweet" Gordone (Leon Isaac Kennedy) tries keeping his nose clean after being paroled from prison. He could box, but he doesn't want to go back to that life. He works as a deliveryman instead, and starts seeing his old girlfriend, Clarisse (Eugenia Wright). But a psychotic criminal, Half Dead (Ernie Hudson), who was Gordone's enemy in prison, breaks out and kills Clarisse as payback. The murder forces Gordone back into the ring, and he is desperate to get revenge against Half Dead. (Action) - 1982

screenpixvoices.us.title: Diggstown
screenpixvoices.us.description: After being released from a Georgia prison, smooth-talking con man Gabriel Caine (James Woods) teams up with his partner in crime, Fitz (Oliver Platt), and travels to remote Diggstown. Upon arriving, Fitz and Caine bet the wealthiest resident, former boxing manager John Gillon (Bruce Dern), that they know a guy who can beat Diggstown's 10 best fighters in one day. After Caine reels in "Honey" Roy Palmer (Louis Gossett Jr.), an aging boxer and old acquaintance, the grift is on. (Action) - 1992

screenpixvoices.us.title: Hammer
screenpixvoices.us.description: Hotheaded laborer B.J. Hammer (Fred Williamson) can't go long without ending up in a fight, and, after he comes out on top in a particularly impressive workplace scuffle, word of his brawling skills makes its way to Davis (Bernie Hamilton), a top boxing manager. Hammer is hired by Davis and begins a lucrative career in the ring, only to find out that his new employer wants him to throw a fight and take part in other illicit activities. Hammer reacts to this news violently, and the feud is on. (Crime drama, Action) - 1972

screenpixvoices.us.title: Body and Soul
screenpixvoices.us.description: Leon Johnson (Leon Isaac Kennedy) is a boxer who plans to study medicine, but, with his ailing sister, Kelly (Nikki Swassy), in need of costly care, he decides to earn a living in the ring. His rise is rapid, but Leon's newly extravagant lifestyle threatens his relationship with girlfriend Julie (Jayne Kennedy). As Leon approaches the sport's highest echelons, he faces increasingly tough decisions that test his loyalty to his family and himself. (Drama) - 1981

screenpixvoices.us.title: Penitentiary
screenpixvoices.us.description: Hitchhiker Martel "Too Sweet" Gordone gets a lift from prostitute Linda in her van and travels with her to meet her clients. After a fight breaks out with the men, Gordone is knocked unconscious and awakens to find he has been wrongly charged with murder. As a way to protect himself in prison, Gordone starts fighting other inmates. This leads him to discover an underground boxing tournament, with the top prize being a prison release. (Drama) - 1979

They dispatch a few men to neutralize the local ferryman, Travis (Lee Van Cleef), but he and flinty mountain man Phil (Forrest Tucker) foil the scheme. By the time Jake reaches the river, Travis has already taken everyone from the town to the Mexican side. He refuses passage to the mercenaries, and a lengthy standoff ensues. (Western, Drama) - 1970

When businessman Carl Beldon (George Eldredge) comes to Johnstown looking to make a deal with local ranchers rather than Travers, he suddenly goes missing. U.S. marshals Gibson (Hoot Gibson) and Steele (Bob Steele) are then called in to search for Beldon, but as they investigate they find themselves shadowed by a deadly gang employed by Travers. Beale and his men join up with an escaped bank robber, Clint McDonald (John Ireland), who is impersonating a doctor. When one of Beale's men discovers McDonald's fraud, he blackmails the thief for a share of the bank loot. But then a far more menacing threat emerges in the form of American Indian warriors. Although Buffalo Horn has a solid alibi for the time of the killing, the political and business corruption of the territory makes a fair trial difficult. (Western) - 1960

Deputy Marshal Bill Gantry (Bill Williams) is charged with investigating the matter to ensure that his close friend Smeed was in the right. When he gets too close to discovering the truth, the crooked deputy tries to make Gantry his next victim. (Western) - 1956

But when they run into a group of murderous Apaches, Hamish and Kallen must fight together to survive, and they form an unlikely friendship. (Western) - 1957

Ives (Warner Anderson) then orders the construction of a military base on Native American territory. While the surviving Cheyenne men plot their revenge, warrior Fireknife (Lee Van Cleef) contacts his friend cavalry scout Adam Reed (Rory Calhoun), and warns him of the bloodbath that will occur if Ives doesn't retreat from the area. Initially, Matt plans on selling the ranch, but then decides to keep it, hoping to impress his ex-lover, Janet (Terry Moore). secnetwork.us.title: The Paul Finebaum Show
secnetwork.us.description: Veteran writer, reporter and radio personality Paul Finebaum built a legion of loyal sports fans as the "Voice of the SEC" during 20 years hosting his Birmingham, Ala.-based radio talk show. When ESPN launched the SEC Network in 2014, it was only natural that Finebaum became its first on-air hire, bringing his radio show -- and those passionate followers -- with him. Now originating from one of the SEC Network studios in Charlotte, N.C., the show is a forum for lively discussion and debate of all things SEC and across the spectrum of college sports, with Finebaum playing the role of both moderator and provocateur. The show airs weekday afternoons throughout the year on SEC Network. (Sports talk, Interview) - 2013-12-02
