teennick.us.description: When Lincoln and Clyde discover a centuries-old pirate flag, they accidentally awaken the ghost of a vengeful zombie pirate and his octopus sidekick; during a nature hike gone wrong, Leni clashes with a snarky co-counselor. (Animated, Children, Comedy) - 2025-08-03

teennick.us.title: The Loud House - Summer Camp: Ticked Off
teennick.us.description: The Loud family and Clyde arrive for a fun-filled summer at Camp Mastodon, but Lincoln and Clyde quickly find themselves in a battle against the toughest bunk at camp. (Animated, Children, Comedy) - 2025-08-01

teennick.us.title: The Loud House - Cheer Pressure; Stroke of Luck
teennick.us.description: The cheerleaders challenge Lynn and her teammates to a cheer-off when Lynn dismisses them as athletes; Lori becomes a celebrity at school when she hits a hole-in-one on a notoriously difficult course. (Animated, Children, Comedy) - 2022-09-09

teennick.us.title: The Loud House - Pulp Friction; Pets Peeved
teennick.us.description: Lincoln and Clyde submit an Ace Savvy comic to a meet-the-creator contest, but are foiled by a surprising nemesis; when Lana brings home a new pet, whom the children adore, the four original Loud pets scheme to get rid of him. (Animated, Children, Comedy) - 2017-05-15

teennick.us.title: The Loud House - The Loudest Mission: Relative Chaos
teennick.us.description: When Ronnie Anne and Bobby visit their crazy extended family, Bobby fits in great, but Ronnie Anne struggles with the smothering nature of their relatives. (Animated, Children, Comedy) - 2017-05-29

teennick.us.title: The Loud House - Net Gains; Pipe Dreams
teennick.us.description: Lynn desperately wants to win a basketball championship but gets drafted onto a terrible team; Mom and Dad decide to build a secret bathroom after they become sick of waiting their turn in line. (Animated, Children, Comedy) - 2018-03-16

teennick.us.title: The Loud House - Rumor Has It; Training Day
teennick.us.description: Lincoln and the gang are trapped in the woods with Mr. Bolhofner, who may not be who he says he is; Lana gets more than she bargained for when she takes on Stella. (Animated, Children, Comedy) - 2021-05-14

teennick.us.title: Henry Danger - Escape Room
teennick.us.description: Kid Danger and Captain Man enter an escape room by a factory owner with a "chip" on his shoulder, and become trapped inside with two new kids, Mika and Miles, who are oddly good at solving the puzzles they need to answer to get out. (Children, Sitcom) - 2020-02-08

teennick.us.title: Henry Danger - The Beginning of the End
teennick.us.description: Kid Danger reveals to Captain Man that he doesn't want to be stuck in Swellview and be his sidekick forever; to make matters worse, Kid Danger is recruited by another town to be their hero. (Children, Sitcom) - 2020-02-29

teennick.us.title: Henry Danger - My Phony Valentine
teennick.us.description: When Henry's crush goes on a date with someone else, Schwoz provides an android to make her jealous; Ray has an unpleasant date with one of Henry's teachers. (Children, Holiday, Sitcom) - 2015-02-14

teennick.us.title: Henry Danger - Caved In
teennick.us.description: Henry, Charlotte and Ray are trapped inside when Jasper accidentally triggers the emergency lockdown mode for Junk-N-Stuff and the Man Cave. (Children, Sitcom) - 2015-02-28

teennick.us.title: Henry Danger - My Dinner With Bigfoot
teennick.us.description: When the gang befriends Bigfoot in the woods, Kid Danger and Captain Man try to help get rid of a pesky hunter that's been trying to capture him. (Children, Sitcom) - 2019-03-09

teennick.us.title: Henry Danger - Brawl in the Hall
teennick.us.description: When Charlotte is challenged to a fight at school, Captain Man and Kid Danger step in to try and help Charlotte defend herself. (Children, Sitcom) - 2017-11-04

teennick.us.title: Henry Danger - Grand Theft Otto
teennick.us.description: When Piper's school parrot, Otto, starts to repeat that Henry is Kid Danger, Henry and Jasper have to stall until Ray, Charlotte and Schwoz can find a way to fix things. (Children, Sitcom) - 2019-02-16

teennick.us.title: Henry Danger - License to Fly
teennick.us.description: Ray agrees to let Henry fly his helicopter, but Ray starts to act like a nervous parent; Charlotte, Jasper and Piper find a cotton candy machine. (Children, Sitcom) - 2017-04-15

teennick.us.title: Henry Danger - The Great Cactus Con
teennick.us.description: Jasper gets the chance to take his crush to Cactus Con, but when a mysterious villain gets involved in the convention, the entire gang is forced into action. (Children, Sitcom) - 2018-11-24

teennick.us.title: Henry Danger - Car Trek
teennick.us.description: Charlotte's birthday road trip to see the Boo Man Group perform gets sidetracked by a Captain Man and Kid Danger emergency. (Children, Sitcom) - 2018-04-28

teennick.us.title: Henry Danger - Mr. Nice Guy
teennick.us.description: A vigilante in a smiley-face mask punishes Swellviewians for being rude in public; Kid Danger and Captain Man's investigation leads them to the TV set of Mr. Wallabee, a local TV celebrity who hosts a show for children. (Children, Sitcom) - 2020-01-11

teennick.us.title: Henry Danger - Henry's Jelly
teennick.us.description: After Jasper is lauded for being a local hero, Henry becomes jealous that Kid Danger is the one getting all the thanks. (Children, Sitcom) - 2015-11-21

teennick.us.title: Henry Danger - Text, Lies & Video
teennick.us.description: When a video of Henry and Ray transforming into Kid Danger and Captain Man gets out, Henry must go to great lengths to retrieve it and protect his secret identity. (Children, Sitcom) - 2016-04-09

teennick.us.title: Henry Danger - Whistlin' Susie
teennick.us.description: After activating an atomic bomb in the Man Cave, Ray and Henry decide to drive it out into the Swellview desert in order to save their city. (Children, Sitcom) - 2018-11-10

teennick.us.title: The Thundermans - Nowhere to Slide
teennick.us.description: The Thunder family splits up for the night; the boys decide to survive 24 hours in the wilderness, while the girls try to bond over some of Barb's favorite farm activities from her childhood. (Children, Sitcom) - 2018-01-27

teennick.us.title: The Thundermans - Original Prankster
teennick.us.description: Despite promising his girlfriend that he would stop pulling pranks, Max pulls an epic gag that his friend gets blamed for. (Children, Sitcom) - 2016-06-11

teennick.us.title: The Thundermans - The Thundreth
teennick.us.description: Phoebe and Max are determined to make their 100th save their best and most memorable one yet, but by ignoring a series of small saves they overlook a supervillain plotting revenge on Hank and Barb. (Children, Sitcom) - 2018-05-25

teennick.us.title: The Thundermans - Looperheroes
teennick.us.description: The Z-Force gives Max and Phoebe a superhero day off, but when they relive the day over and over again, they must find a way to break the loop.

teennick.us.title: The Thundermans - The Neverfriending Story
teennick.us.description: When Phoebe and Max's friends begin spending time with each other, the twins worry that they will be stuck together all the time.

teennick.us.title: The Thundermans - Date Expectations
teennick.us.description: Phoebe distracts Max from interfering with her class project by convincing him that a girl at school wants to date him.

teennick.us.title: The Thundermans: Undercover - Party All the Crime
teennick.us.description: Chloe's birthday party is cancelled, and Max and Phoebe compete to throw her a new one; when Max's time-stopping birthday gift falls into the wrong hands, he must work with Phoebe to stop some party poopers from ruining Chloe's birthday.

teennick.us.title: The Thundermans: Undercover - Bummer School
teennick.us.description: Chloe, Jinx and Booch are designing a school mascot, but Max and Phoebe's feud over their jobs ruins the project; Chloe criticizes them, and the twins realize their fighting affects Chloe now that they're guardians.

teennick.us.title: The Loud House - Time Trap!
teennick.us.description: When the kids break Mom and Dad's priceless vase, they decide the only thing to do is go back in time to their wedding day and prevent them from ever receiving it.

teennick.us.title: The Loud House - Save Royal Woods!
teennick.us.description: When Royal Woods is in danger of being flooded to make room for a sixth Great Lake, the town comes together to prove that they're worth saving.

teennick.us.title: The Loud House - Good Sports; Geri-Antics
teennick.us.description: Lynn finds an unexpected TV sports-watching buddy in the family's next-door neighbor, Mr. Grouse; when Lisa realizes that Pop Pop won't be around forever, she turns to science to ensure his longevity.

teennick.us.title: The Loud House - Snow Way Out; Snow Way Down
teennick.us.description: Lana convinces the children to go to the Burpin' Burger to meet her racecar driving hero despite the heavy snowfall; when Lincoln goes on vacation with Clyde, he realizes how overprotective Clyde's parents are.

teennick.us.title: The Loud House - Washed Up; Recipe for Disaster
teennick.us.description: The Louds rent a boat for a relaxing day trip on the lake, but the family ends up marooned on a desert island; Lincoln and Clyde, as Ace and Jack, investigate when they discover a frozen food company is using Dad's recipes.

teennick.us.title: The Loud House - Road Trip: From Brad to Worse; Road Trip: Doll Day Afternoon
teennick.us.description: When the Louds run into Mom's old camp crush turned celebrity at a State Fair, Dad tries to one-up him to impress Rita; Mr. Coconuts is missing and Luan rallies the Louds to track him down along Route 66.

teennick.us.title: The Loud House - A Star Is Scorned; Senior Moment
teennick.us.description: Lola realizes that double the cuteness could help her break into show business, so she teams up with Lily; Lori vows to make up for lost time in her senior year.

teennick.us.title: The Loud House - Space Jammed; Crown and Dirty
teennick.us.description: Annoyed by Leni's intrusive babysitting, Lisa accidentally blasts herself and Todd into space; Lola tries to whip Mom into tip-top pageant condition for a mother-daughter pageant.

teennick.us.title: The Loud House - Don't You Fore-get About Me; Tough Cookies
teennick.us.description: Hit by the realization that her big sister will be going off to college soon, Leni tries to thwart Lori's plans; Lincoln and Clyde start their own cookie-making business, but realize it's a lot more work than they realized.

teennick.us.title: The Loud House - Project Loud House; In Tents Debate
teennick.us.description: Lincoln has to get his sisters out the door so he can be on time for school; Lincoln holds the deciding vote for the family vacation.

teennick.us.title: The Loud House - Crashed Course; Puns and Buns
teennick.us.description: The Loud siblings intervene when they think Lori is failing out of Fairway U; Benny struggles to rein in Luan and her practical jokes when she becomes his coworker at the Burpin' Burger.

teennick.us.title: The Loud House - Blinded by Science; Band Together
teennick.us.description: Lisa searches for the next big scientific breakthrough; Luna decides whether to play in a band with her friends or play with professionals.

teennick.us.title: The Loud House - Nonna Your Business/Alpining Away
teennick.us.description: The Louds journey to Naples, Italy to taste the world's best pizza, made by a secretive and legendary chef; When Lynn crushes on a boy in the Swiss Alps, Lori and Leni become her crush-coaches to help her talk to him.

teennick.us.title: The Loud House - City Slickers; Fool Me Twice
teennick.us.description: Lori and Lincoln visit the city, where Lori struggles to be a city girl; Lincoln finds that Ronnie Anne has changed; the family uses stunt doubles in its plan to avoid Luan's April Fool's Day pranking.

teennick.us.title: The Loud House - For Bros About to Rock; It's a Loud, Loud, Loud, Loud House
teennick.us.description: Lincoln is going to his first rock concert, and Luna is determined to make it the greatest experience ever; when Lincoln finds a letter in the attic, he begins to believe there is money hidden somewhere in the house.

teennick.us.title: The Loud House - Silence of the Luans; Undercover Mom
teennick.us.description: Luan is locked in a cell in the basement; Mom goes undercover as a student at the high school and becomes best friends with Leni, Luna and Luan.

teennick.us.title: The Loud House - The Mad Scientist; Missed Connection
teennick.us.description: Lisa gets invited to work at an institute and get away from her crazy family; Lori and Bobby worry that long-distance dating is causing them to lose their connection.

teennick.us.title: The Loud House - Cow Pie Kid; Saved by the Spell
teennick.us.description: Lynn pushes Liam to his limits when he becomes the star pitcher for the middle school baseball team; Lincoln's friends try to stop him from performing a magic act at the middle school talent show.

teennick.us.title: The Loud House - Deep Cuts; Game Off
teennick.us.description: When Luna discovers that the high school music club will be axed due to budget cuts, she leads a protest; desperate to play Lincoln's trash-themed video game, Lana conspires to distract her brother away from the console.

teennick.us.title: The Loud House - Back Out There; Spell It Out
teennick.us.description: Clyde, worried that Lincoln is hung up on Ronnie Anne, tries to cure his post-breakup blues; tired of her siblings walking all over her, Lucy turns to a spell book to teach her siblings a lesson.

teennick.us.title: The Loud House - Legends; Mall of Duty
teennick.us.description: Dad and Lincoln get on "Legends of the Hidden Temple" and cannot wait to for a whole day of father-and-son bonding; Lincoln wants to go to the mall but has to watch his younger sisters, so he decides to take them to the mall.

teennick.us.title: The Loud House - Dine and Bash; Sofa, So Good
teennick.us.description: After failing to make chef Guy Grazer a meal on his show, the kids try to erase the footage before it airs; the kids search all over Royal Woods to find the missing furniture they left outside while cleaning.

teennick.us.title: The Loud House - The Loud Cloud; You Auto Know Better
teennick.us.description: Tired of Mom's sticky note system, Lincoln and Lisa create an app to keep track of the family's schedule; Lana creates an auto body shop to try and buy a new bike, but her shop turns corrupt when Flip becomes her mentor.

teennick.us.title: The Loud House - No Laughing Matter; No Spoilers
teennick.us.description: When Luan overhears her siblings complaining about her comedy, she decides to give it up; knowing Leni's history of spoiling surprises, the children decide not to tell her about their mother's upcoming party.

teennick.us.title: The Loud House - Europe Road Trip: A Bite in Transylvania; Greece Is the Word
teennick.us.description: When the Loud's bus gets a flat tire, they're invited to stay the night in a spooky couple's mysterious castle; during a tour of the Parthenon, Lincoln puts on a soldier's helmet which sends him back to Ancient Greece.

teennick.us.title: The Loud House - School of Shock; Electshunned
teennick.us.description: Lisa takes over her first-grade classroom and learns that there's more to teaching than just knowing facts; Leni goes toe-to-toe with the mayor in a citywide Royal Woods election.

teennick.us.title: The Loud House - Change of Heart; Health Kicked
teennick.us.description: Clyde is desperate to learn how to act normal around Lori, so he enlists Leni's help; worried that their parents are hurting their health from not being active, the children encourage them to exercise.

teennick.us.title: The Loud House - Don't Escar-go; Double Trouble
teennick.us.description: When Clyde receives an opportunity to study cooking in France, the gang tries to keep him closer to home; Lola and Lana take on Cheryl and Meryl for the position of twin spokespeople for Auntie Pam's Parlor.

teennick.us.title: The Loud House - Kings of the Con
teennick.us.description: Eager to be named Kings of the Con at the Ace Savvy convention, Lincoln and Clyde convince the sisters to go with them as the Full Deck; when the girls get more attention, the boys do whatever it takes to gain focus.

teennick.us.title: The Loud House - Pop Pop the Question; Lynn and Order
teennick.us.description: When the kids discover Myrtle has a shady past, they try to expose her before Pop Pop proposes; Lynn and Liam butt heads when they're forced to partner up as the middle school hall monitors.

teennick.us.title: The Loud House - Suite and Sour; Back in Black
teennick.us.description: When the Loud parents win a trip to a resort, they decide to take the children with them because the children have promised to behave; when Lucy gets a crush on a "regular and normal" boy, her sisters decide to give her a makeover.

teennick.us.title: The Loud House - Music to my Fears; Fluff and Foiled
teennick.us.description: Luna and the Moon Goats have to find a replacement guitarist for the band when Luna injures her hands from playing; to make it to Udder Madness Day at Dairyland, Lincoln is determined to get laundry duty finished quickly.

teennick.us.title: Henry Danger - Meet Cute Crush
teennick.us.description: Henry and Ray try to help Piper get to know a new boy she likes from school.

themoviechannel.us.title: Flypaper
themoviechannel.us.description: A man tries to protect a teller, whom he secretly loves, after two groups rob her bank at the same time. (Comedy, Crime drama) - 2011

themoviechannel.us.title: View From the Top
themoviechannel.us.description: A comedy about a young woman from meager beginnings, who has high hopes for the future. Donna (Gwyneth Paltrow) dreams of becoming a first-class international flight attendant and is willing to do whatever it takes to ensure that her dreams come true. The road to success, though, is rarely a smooth flight, and as she begins her trip she encounters more turbulence than even she bargained for. (Comedy, Romance, Drama) - 2003

themoviechannel.us.title: Yours, Mine & Ours
themoviechannel.us.description: When Coast Guard Adm. Frank Beardsley (Dennis Quaid) decides to move his family of eight children back to his old hometown, he encounters handbag designer Helen North (Rene Russo), an old flame from high school. Immediately, sparks fly between the two, and marriage is proposed. But Frank isn't the only one with kids to worry about -- Helen has a total of 10. Right away, the children have no intention of playing nicely, and together they decide to sabotage their parents' relationship. (Children, Comedy) - 2005

themoviechannel.us.title: Old School
themoviechannel.us.description: After discovering his girlfriend has been participating in group sex, attorney Mitch feels his world come undone. He moves into a new place, which happens to be near a college campus, and tries to get his life back together. Two of his best friends, Frank and Beanie, start hanging out at Mitch's house, eventually turning the place into a wild party pad, much to the ire of the college's dean, Gordon "Cheese" Pritchard. (Comedy) - 2003

themoviechannel.us.title: Kingpin
themoviechannel.us.description: Roy Munson (Woody Harrelson) is a young bowler with a promising career ahead of him until a disreputable colleague, Ernie McCracken (Bill Murray), tricks him into participating in a con game that ends with Roy's bowling hand crippled for life. Years later, Roy ekes out a hardscrabble existence until he discovers Amish bowling phenom Ishmael (Randy Quaid). With the help of a gangster's girlfriend (Vanessa Angel), he plots to take Ishmael to the top of the bowling world. (Comedy) - 1996

themoviechannel.us.title: The Brothers Grimm
themoviechannel.us.description: The Brothers Grimm, Wilhelm and Jacob, are dysfunctional schemers who go from town to town putting on shows that convince inhabitants they are getting rid of demons. After one such scam, a mysterious man called Cavaldi brings them to a French general, who persuades them to battle the evil that has kidnapped 10 girls from a small village. During the investigation, the cynical Wilhelm and sensitive Jacob see things that point to real magic at work. (Fantasy, Adventure, Mystery, Thriller) - 2005

themoviechannel.us.title: Hugo
themoviechannel.us.description: Orphaned and alone except for an uncle, Hugo Cabret lives in the walls of a train station in the 1930s Paris. Hugo's job is to oil and maintain the station's clocks, but to him, his more important task is to protect a broken automaton and notebook left to him by his late father. Accompanied by the goddaughter of an embittered toy merchant, Hugo embarks on a quest to solve the mystery of the automaton and find a place he can call home. (Adventure, Fantasy, Drama) - 2011

themoviechannel.us.title: Mr. Holmes
themoviechannel.us.description: Long-retired and near the end of his life, Sherlock Holmes (Ian McKellen) grapples with an unreliable memory and must rely on his housekeeper's son as he revisits the still-unsolved case that led to his retirement. (Mystery, Drama) - 2015

themoviechannel.us.title: Our Ghosts
themoviechannel.us.description: Hiding in the attic of his former apartment, a widowed and jobless father tries to scare the new tenant so he can live there once again. (Comedy drama) - 2021

themoviechannel.us.title: Three Wishes
themoviechannel.us.description: When single mother Jeanne Holman turns to avoid hitting a dog with her station wagon, she unwittingly hits bearded drifter Jack McCloud. Against the protests of her scandalized neighbors, Holman insists that the injured man stay at the Holman residence to heal. As the eccentric McCloud recovers from the accident, he becomes a positive influence on -- and an unexpected father figure to -- her young sons, Tom and Gunny. (Fantasy) - 1995

themoviechannel.us.title: The Fitzgerald Family Christmas
themoviechannel.us.description: Rifts emerge among family members when their long-estranged patriarch decides to come home for the holidays. (Holiday, Comedy drama) - 2012

themoviechannel.us.title: Smoke Signals
themoviechannel.us.description: Arnold (Gary Farmer) rescued Thomas (Evan Adams) from a fire when he was a child. Thomas thinks of Arnold as a hero, while Arnold's son Victor (Adam Beach) resents his father's alcoholism, violence and abandonment of his family. Uneasy rivals and friends, Thomas and Victor spend their days killing time on a Coeur d'Alene reservation in Idaho and arguing about their cultural identities. When Arnold dies, the duo set out on a cross-country journey to Phoenix to retrieve Arnold's ashes. (Comedy drama) - 1998

themoviechannel.us.title: Smart People
themoviechannel.us.description: Acerbic, selfish and widowed, literature professor Lawrence Wetherhold (Dennis Quaid) is estranged from his son and his overachieving teenage daughter. Just as he begins a relationship with a former student (Sarah Jessica Parker), Lawrence's ne'er-do-well adoptive brother (Thomas Haden Church) lands on his doorstep. Lawrence realizes he must make some changes in his life and reconnect with his children in order to get on with his life. (Romantic comedy, Drama) - 2008

themoviechannel.us.title: Planes, Trains and Automobiles
themoviechannel.us.description: Easily excitable Neal Page (Steve Martin) is somewhat of a control freak. Trying to get home to Chicago to spend Thanksgiving with his wife (Laila Robins) and kids, his flight is rerouted to a distant city in Kansas because of a freak snowstorm, and his sanity begins to fray. Worse yet, he is forced to bunk up with talkative Del Griffith (John Candy), whom he finds extremely annoying. Together they must overcome the insanity of holiday travel to reach their intended destination. (Holiday, Comedy, Adventure) - 1987

themoviechannel.us.title: The Contractor
themoviechannel.us.description: Involuntarily discharged from the Army, a special forces sergeant lands a contract with a private underground military force. When his very first assignment goes awry, the elite soldier finds himself hunted and on the run, caught in a dangerous conspiracy and fighting to stay alive long enough to get home and uncover the true motives of those who betrayed him. (Action, Thriller) - 2022

themoviechannel.us.title: There Will Be Blood
themoviechannel.us.description: Silver miner Daniel Plainview (Daniel Day-Lewis) leads a hardscrabble life with his son, H.W. (Dillon Freasier). When he hears about oil oozing from the ground near the Western town of Little Boston, Daniel takes his son on a mission to find their fortune. Daniel makes his lucky strike and becomes a self-made tycoon but, as his fortune grows, he deviates into moral bankruptcy. (Drama) - 2007

themoviechannel.us.title: The Dutchman
themoviechannel.us.description: Haunted by his crumbling marriage and an identity crisis, a successful but troubled businessman gets drawn into a psychological game of cat and mouse with a sinister, mysterious woman whom he encounters on a New York subway. (Thriller, Drama) - 2025

themoviechannel.us.title: The Faculty
themoviechannel.us.description: To the students at Harrington High, the principal and her posse of teachers have always been a little odd, but lately they've been behaving positively alien. Controlled by otherworldly parasites, the faculty try to infect students one by one. Cheerleader Delilah (Jordana Brewster), football player Stan (Shawn Hatosy), drug dealer Zeke (Josh Hartnett) and new girl Marybeth (Laura Harris) team up with some of their other classmates to fight back against the invaders. (Horror, Science fiction, Mystery) - 1998

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Wise Girl
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: A socialite (Miriam Hopkins) goes Bohemian to save her sister's children from their starving-artist father (Ray Milland) in Greenwich Village. (Comedy) - 1937

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Traveling Saleslady
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: A toothpaste tycoon's daughter (Joan Blondell) sells an inventor's new brand to teach her father a lesson. (Comedy) - 1935

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: There Goes My Heart
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: Eager to break free of her constrained life, heiress Joan Butterfield (Virginia Bruce) runs away from her grandfather's yacht just as reporter Bill Spencer (Fredric March) arrives to get a rare photo of her. Befriended by the kind Peggy (Patsy Kelly), Joan takes an assumed name and moves in with Peggy, then joins her working at Butterfield's department store. Bill, who has begun an article on Joan, visits the store and, recognizing her there, realizes that he has stumbled upon a hot story. (Romance) - 1938

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Repent at Leisure
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: A young man falls in love with his boss's daughter. (Comedy drama) - 1941

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Love and Learn
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: A New York socialite (Martha Vickers) plays working girl around two struggling songwriters (Jack Carson, Robert Hutton). (Musical comedy) - 1947

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: The Richest Girl in the World
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: Dorothy Hunter (Miriam Hopkins), the richest girl in the world, has never shown her face to the public. When she arrives in America, Dorothy switches places with her secretary, Sylvia (Fay Wray), to avoid the press. But after Dorothy's fiancé (George Meeker) proclaims his love for another woman, she wonders if any man can love her for more than her money. Still disguised as a secretary, Dorothy falls for Tony (Joel McCrea) and puts him through a series of tests to prove his affections. (Comedy) - 1934

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Bride by Mistake
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: The staggeringly wealthy Norah Hunter (Laraine Day), a shipyard owner, too often finds herself the romantic target of gold-digging men. To attract a suitor whose main interest is not money, she changes places with her secretary, Sylvia Lockwood (Marsha Hunt), and assumes the role of a young working woman. However, she then falls for recuperating fighter pilot Anthony Travis (Alan Marshal), who, in turn, is madly in love with Sylvia -- or, perhaps, with the millions he thinks she has. (Drama) - 1944

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Sun Valley Serenade
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: As a surefire way to receive good press, bandleader Phil Corey (Glenn Miller) and his ensemble decide to adopt a war refugee. When it turns out that their adoptee isn't a child, but a pretty Scandinavian woman named Karen Benson (Sonja Henie), it leads to a flirtatious relationship with the group's pianist, Ted Scott (John Payne), who is already involved with singer Vivian Dawn (Lynn Bari). As the band heads to snowy Idaho for a gig, romantic drama, skiing, ice skating and musical numbers ensue. (Musical, Romance) - 1941

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Orchestra Wives
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: When a touring swing band arrives in her small town, Connie Ward (Ann Rutherford) falls hard for trumpeter Bill Abbot (George Montgomery) and decides to marry him on a whim -- since the band is leaving as quickly as it arrived. Quite unprepared for her new lifestyle, Connie struggles to adjust to the constant travel from one town to another, and also to the pettiness of the other musicians' wives. Eventually, the marriage and the band break up, but Bill is determined to make it all right again. (Musical, Romance) - 1942

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Birth of the Blues
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: Jeff Lambert (Bing Crosby), who has grown up in New Orleans surrounded by black music, determines to start a band featuring white cornet player Memphis (Brian Donlevy). However, the Basin Street Hotshots are rejected from several venues for playing "black" jazz, until singer Betty Lou Cobb (Mary Martin) insists they be hired as her backup band. The band finds success until Jeff and Memphis fall out over Betty Lou, then get entangled with gangster Blackie (J. Carrol Naish). (Musical) - 1941

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Girl Crazy
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: Distracted by female students and performing poorly in the classroom, Danny Churchill Jr. (Mickey Rooney) moves west to a university that his father believes is free of temptation. Soon, though, Danny strikes up a friendship with Ginger Gray (Judy Garland). When Ginger, whose family runs the all-male college, explains that the school has money troubles, creative Danny puts together a big fundraiser. The event highlights their song-and-dance skills and also cements their bond. (Musical comedy) - 1943

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Strike Up the Band
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: Teenage drummer Jimmy Connors dreams of winning the contest for school bands hosted by popular band leader Paul Whiteman (himself). In order to enter, Jimmy and his pals, including charming vocalist Mary Holden, must accumulate $200 for the train ride to Chicago, where the contest will be held. Jimmy and his friends decide to put on an epic student play to raise the funds they need, but a sudden illness threatens to cost the band their chance. (Musical comedy) - 1940

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Pot o' Gold
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: Jimmy, the owner of a failed music shop, goes to work with his uncle, the owner of a food factory. Before he gets there, he befriends an Irish family who happens to be his uncle's worst enemy because of their love for music and in-house band that constantly practices. Soon, Jimmy finds himself trying to help the band by getting them gigs and trying to reconcile the family with his uncle, an avid music-hater. (Musical comedy) - 1941

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: God Is My Co-Pilot
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: Col. Robert L. Scott is an adept fighter pilot who unfortunately finds himself too old to fly fighter planes in World War II. Assigned to India, he later meets Maj. Gen. Claire L. Chennault, who commands the famous "Flying Tigers" squadron in China. Chennault finally allows Scott to learn combat flying techniques on an obsolete training plane. Scott is so good that Chennault gives him his wish -- he will fly combat missions with the Tigers. (Biography) - 1945

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: My Wild Irish Rose
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: In this musical, Chauncey Olcott (Dennis Morgan) -- a character based on the real-life 19th-century singer-songwriter -- starts off as a minstrel show performer, but his life and career completely change when singer Lillian Russell (Andrea King) gives him a starring role in a Broadway show. Olcott's girlfriend, Rose (Arlene Dahl), gets jealous, suspecting an affair. But in spite of his relationship battles, Olcott's star rises with a series of ballads, including the title track. (Musical) - 1947

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Two Guys From Milwaukee
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: While waiting for his Balkan country to vote on whether to abolish its monarchy, Prince Henry (Dennis Morgan) comes to New York City to observe ordinary life. Slipping away in disguise from his welcome party, the prince becomes friends with cab driver Buzz Williams (Jack Carson). After Buzz discovers the prince's identity, he lets his girlfriend, Connie (Joan Leslie), show the royal around the city. As the public wonders where the prince has disappeared to, he and Connie fall in love. (Comedy) - 1946

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: The Desert Song
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: A man leads a group of desert bandits against some Nazis, who want to use them as cheap labor for their railroad. (Musical) - 1943

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Vengeance Valley
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: Adopted by the wealthy rancher Arch Strobie, orphan Owen Daybright (Burt Lancaster) grows to be a respectable foreman on Strobie's ranch. Strobie's natural son, Lee (Robert Walker), is jealous of Owen and finally finds a way to undermine his upstanding brother. When Lee conceives an illegitimate child with Lily Fasken (Sally Forrest), who refuses to name him as the father, he tells her revenge-minded brothers that Owen is to blame, hoping they'll take his half-brother out of the picture. (Western) - 1951

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Ten Tall Men
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: Sgt. Mike Kincaid is a rough-and-tumble French Foreign Legion leader who, while imprisoned in a stockade, overhears rumors of an enemy attack on his company's fort. Later, in between fighting amongst themselves over a beautiful French lady, Mike and his ragtag group of fighters improvise a plan to kidnap Mahla (Jody Lawrence), the daughter of a local sheik. Though she hates Mike and his band of thieves at first, she soon realizes they are the least of her worries. (Action) - 1951

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Sweet Smell of Success
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: An all-powerful New York gossip columnist (Burt Lancaster) gives a press agent (Tony Curtis) some dirty work. - 1957

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: From Here to Eternity
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: While a Japanese attack on Pearl Harbor looms, an Army sergeant (Burt Lancaster), a former boxer (Montgomery Clift) and an officer's wife (Deborah Kerr) become entangled with others at an Army base on Oahu. - 1953

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Gunfight at the O.K. Corral
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: Doc Holliday (Kirk Douglas) joins Wyatt Earp (Burt Lancaster) and his brothers for a Tombstone showdown with the Clanton gang. - 1957

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Come Back, Little Sheba
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: A housewife (Shirley Booth) and her alcoholic husband (Burt Lancaster) rent a spare room to a pretty student (Terry Moore). - 1952

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Trapeze
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: Two aerialists (Burt Lancaster, Tony Curtis) and a tumbler (Gina Lollobrigida) form a triple-somersault circus triangle. - 1956

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Jim Thorpe, All American
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: Coach Pop Warner (Charles Bickford) recalls the Oklahoma Indian (Burt Lancaster) forced to return his medals from the 1912 Olympics. - 1951

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: It's Always Fair Weather
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: A talk-show staffer (Cyd Charisse) puts a fight manager (Gene Kelly), adman (Dan Dailey) and cook on TV 10 years after they parted as GIs. - 1955

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: The Lost Squadron
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: A Prussian director (Erich von Stroheim) demands realism from a Hollywood stunt pilot (Richard Dix) and his buddies. - 1932

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: I Am a Fugitive From a Chain Gang
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: An innocent man is sent to a prison farm, where he endures the dehumanizing effects of a cruel criminal justice system. - 1932

tvland.us.title: Gunsmoke - Blindman's Bluff
tvland.us.description: A lonely spinster finds romance with a wounded stranger she nurses back to health. (Drama, Western) - 1972-02-21

tvland.us.title: Gunsmoke - Alias Festus Haggin
tvland.us.description: Festus is arrested and forced to stand trial as a murderer named Frank Eaton, who looks just like him. (Drama, Western) - 1972-03-06

tvland.us.title: Gunsmoke - The Wedding
tvland.us.description: A strong-willed daughter marries against the wishes of her domineering father. (Drama, Western) - 1972-03-13

tvland.us.title: Gunsmoke - The River
tvland.us.description: Matt recovers loot from a series of holdups but is pursued by thieves. (Drama, Western) - 1972-09-11

tvland.us.title: Gunsmoke - The River
tvland.us.description: While on a raft with two children, Matt faces a dual threat from the outlaws and a Frenchman he saved earlier. (Drama, Western) - 1972-09-18

tvland.us.title: The Andy Griffith Show - Sheriff Barney
tvland.us.description: A trial run as sheriff of Mayberry convinces Barney that he is not ready for a similar job in a nearby town. (Sitcom) - 1961-12-25

tvland.us.title: The Andy Griffith Show - The Farmer Takes a Wife

actionmax.us.title: Ocean's Twelve
actionmax.us.description: After successfully robbing five casinos in one night, Danny Ocean and his crew of thieves have big problems. Despite pulling off one of the biggest heists in Las Vegas history, the members of the gang have already spent much of the money they stole. Casino owner Terry Benedict demands that Ocean return the money, plus millions more in interest. Unable to come up the cash, the crew is forced to come together to pull off another series of heists, this time in Europe. (Comedy drama, Crime drama) - 2004

actionmax.us.title: Ocean's Thirteen
actionmax.us.description: Danny Ocean and his gang hatch an ambitious plot for revenge after ruthless casino owner Willy Bank double-crosses Reuben Tishkoff, Danny's friend and mentor. First, Ocean's gang plan to hit Bank in the paycheck by reversing the precept that the house always wins. Next, they will deal a crushing blow to Bank's ego by ruining his reputation as the only hotelier to earn the Royal Review's Five Diamond Award for each of his properties. (Comedy drama, Crime drama) - 2007

actionmax.us.title: Ocean's Eight
actionmax.us.description: Debbie Ocean assembles an all-female team of thieves and specialists for a heist during the Met Gala, aiming for the $150 million worth of diamonds around the neck of world-famous actress Daphne Kluger. (Comedy, Crime drama) - 2018

actionmax.us.title: Super Troopers 2
actionmax.us.description: Fired for their previous shenanigans, former Vermont Highway Patrol officers Thorny, Farva, Rabbit, Foster and Mac get a shot at redemption from Capt. O'Hagan and Gov. Jessan. The wacky quintet must provide law enforcement for a French Canadian town that's transitioning to U.S. sovereignty. Their unconventional methods soon get put to the test when they encounter a smarmy mayor, mischievous Mounties, a smuggling ring and a 1,300-pound bear. (Comedy) - 2018

actionmax.us.title: Open Water
actionmax.us.description: Daniel (Daniel Travis) and Susan (Blanchard Ryan) embark on a tropical vacation with their scuba-diving certifications in tow. During a group dive, the two separate themselves from the others to dive a little deeper. An incorrect head-count suggests the entire group has returned, so the boat departs. When the pair surfaces, they make out a vessel in the distance, but it does not immediately set in that they have been left behind. With sharks lurking beneath, their survival chances grow smaller. (Thriller, Adventure, Drama, Horror) - 2003

actionmax.us.title: Pacific Rim Uprising
actionmax.us.description: Jake Pentecost is a once-promising Jaeger pilot whose legendary father gave his life to secure humanity's victory against the monstrous Kaiju. Jake has since abandoned his training only to become caught up in a criminal underworld. But when an even more unstoppable threat is unleashed to tear through cities and bring the world to its knees, Jake is given one last chance by his estranged sister, Mako Mori, to live up to his father's legacy. (Science fiction, Action, Adventure, Fantasy) - 2018

actionmax.us.title: Scream
actionmax.us.description: The sleepy little town of Woodsboro just woke up screaming. There's a killer in their midst who's seen a few too many scary movies. Suddenly nobody is safe, as the psychopath stalks victims, taunts them with trivia questions, then rips them to bloody shreds. It could be anybody. (Horror, Comedy) - 1996

actionmax.us.title: Trap
actionmax.us.description: A man and his teenage daughter realize they're at the center of a dark and sinister event while watching a concert. (Thriller) - 2024

actionmax.us.title: The Watchers
actionmax.us.description: A 28-year-old artist gets stranded in an expansive, untouched forest in western Ireland. Finding shelter, she unknowingly becomes trapped alongside three strangers who are stalked by mysterious creatures every night. (Horror, Thriller) - 2024

actionmax.us.title: Shut In
actionmax.us.description: Mary Portman is a widowed child psychologist who lives in isolation in rural Maine. The horrific car accident that killed her husband also left her 18-year-old stepson Stephen in a bedridden, catatonic state, leaving him completely dependent on her. When one of Portman's young patients vanishes without a trace, she becomes convinced that the boy's ghost is now in the house as a dangerous ice storm starts to wreak havoc outside. (Thriller) - 2016

actionmax.us.title: Godzilla
actionmax.us.description: A U.S. newsman (Raymond Burr) in Tokyo recounts the story of a huge dinosaur roused from the sea by an atomic blast. (Science fiction) - 1956

actionmax.us.title: Godzilla Raids Again
actionmax.us.description: Prehistoric monsters Godzilla and Anguirus battle it out in Osaka, Japan. (Science fiction) - 1955

actionmax.us.title: Son of Godzilla
actionmax.us.description: In this Japanese monster movie, the massive Godzilla comes to the aid of his newborn son, who hatches from an egg on a remote island where scientists are conducting experiments with radioactivity. Revealing a surprising paternal streak, Godzilla tries to teach his much smaller progeny how to use his powers. The father/son team must then battle giant insects, including praying mantises and a formidable spider. Can Godzilla protect his curious tyke from the gargantuan bugs? (Science fiction) - 1967

actionmax.us.title: Full Metal Jacket
actionmax.us.description: Stanley Kubrick's take on the Vietnam War follows smart-aleck Private Davis (Matthew Modine), quickly christened "Joker" by his foul-mouthed drill sergeant (R. Lee Ermey), and pudgy Private Lawrence (Vincent D'Onofrio), nicknamed "Gomer Pyle," as they endure the rigors of basic training. Though Pyle takes a frightening detour, Joker graduates to the Marine Corps and is sent to Vietnam as a journalist, covering -- and eventually participating in -- the bloody Battle of Hue. (War, Historical drama) - 1987

actionmax.us.title: Collision Course
actionmax.us.description: Detroit crime boss Madras hires men to smuggle a top secret, Japanese-made turbocharger into the U.S. But Madras' crooks are murdered, and the turbocharger goes missing. As he searches for the stolen engine, so does straitlaced Tokyo detective Fujitsuka Natsuo. Eventually, local authorities catch wind of the case, and onto the investigation comes brash cop Tony Costas, who must team with his polar opposite, Natsuo, to find the turbocharger. (Action, Comedy) - 1989

actionmax.us.title: Ghost Dog: The Way of the Samurai
actionmax.us.description: Ghost Dog (Forest Whitaker) is a contract killer, a master of his trade who can whirl a gun at warp speed and moves through this world like a phantom -- stealthy and evanescent. In the spirit of the samurai, he has pledged his loyalty to a small time mobster named Louie (John Tormey) who saved his life many years before. (Crime drama) - 1999

actionmax.us.title: Life of Pi
actionmax.us.description: After deciding to sell their zoo in India and move to Canada, Santosh and Gita Patel board a freighter with their sons and a few remaining animals. Tragedy strikes when a terrible storm sinks the ship, leaving the Patels' teenage son, Pi, as the only human survivor. However, Pi is not alone; a fearsome Bengal tiger has also found refuge aboard the lifeboat. As days turn into weeks and weeks drag into months, Pi and the tiger must learn to trust each other if both are to survive. (Adventure, Drama, Fantasy, Mystery) - 2012

actionmax.us.title: Take the Lead
actionmax.us.description: When internationally renowned dancer Pierre Dulaine takes a teaching job in a New York City public school, he meets ridicule from the street-wise students, who scoff at the notion of ballroom dancing. Far from being discouraged, he melds their hip-hop moves with his classical style, helping them create a dance form and, in the process, becoming their mentor. (Musical, Drama) - 2006

moremax.us.title: Get Him to the Greek
moremax.us.description: An ambitious executive at a record company, Aaron Green (Jonah Hill) gets what looks like an easy assignment: He must escort British rock legend Aldous Snow (Russell Brand) to L.A.'s Greek Theatre for the first stop on a lucrative comeback-concert tour. Snow, however, has different plans. Learning his true love is in California, the rocker vows to win her back before starting the tour, forcing Aaron to pull out all the stops to get Snow on stage in time. (Comedy) - 2010

moremax.us.title: The Dilemma
moremax.us.description: Longtime friends Ronny (Vince Vaughn) and Nick (Kevin James) are partners in an auto-design firm. They are hard at work on a presentation for a dream project that would really launch their company. Then Ronny spots Nick's wife out with another man, and in the process of investigating the possible affair, he learns that Nick has a few secrets of his own. As the presentation nears, Ronny agonizes over what might happen if the truth gets out. (Comedy) - 2011

moremax.us.title: MacGruber
moremax.us.description: In the decade since his fiancée was killed, an Army Ranger, Green Beret and Navy SEAL rolled into one has sworn off fighting crime, preferring instead to rock his mullet as a man of peace. But when his sworn enemy, Dieter Von Cunth, steals a nuclear warhead, only MacGruber and his crack team of experts are equal to the task of bringing the villain to justice. (Comedy, Action) - 2010

moremax.us.title: Mojave
moremax.us.description: A down-and-out artist (Garrett Hedlund) has a dangerous and shocking encounter with an evil drifter (Oscar Isaac) in the desert, leading to terrifying consequences when the deadly stranger follows his unsuspecting victim home. (Thriller) - 2015

moremax.us.title: Arctic
moremax.us.description: A man stranded in the Arctic after an airplane crash must decide whether to remain in the relative safety of his makeshift camp or to embark on a deadly trek through the unknown in hopes of making it out alive. (Adventure, Drama) - 2018

moremax.us.title: The Meg
moremax.us.description: Previously thought to be extinct, a massive creature attacks a deep-sea submersible, leaving it disabled and trapping the crew at the bottom of the Pacific. With time running out, a visionary oceanographer recruits rescue diver Jonas Taylor to save the crew and the sea itself from an unimaginable threat a 75-foot-long prehistoric shark known as the Megalodon. (Science fiction, Thriller, Action, Adventure, Horror) - 2018

moremax.us.title: Beetlejuice Beetlejuice
moremax.us.description: Still haunted by Beetlejuice, Lydia's life gets turned upside down when her daughter discovers a portal to the afterlife. When someone says Beetlejuice's name three times, the mischievous demon returns to unleash his very own brand of mayhem. (Fantasy, Horror, Comedy) - 2024

moremax.us.title: Black Adam
moremax.us.description: In ancient Kahndaq, Teth Adam was bestowed the almighty powers of the gods. After using these powers for vengeance, he was imprisoned, becoming Black Adam. Nearly 5,000 years have passed, and Black Adam has gone from man to myth to legend. Now free, his unique form of justice, born out of rage, is challenged by modern-day heroes who form the Justice Society: Hawkman, Dr. Fate, Atom Smasher and Cyclone. (Action, Adventure, Fantasy) - 2022

moremax.us.title: Atomic Blonde
moremax.us.description: Sensual and savage, Lorraine Broughton is the most elite spy in MI6, an agent who's willing to use all of her lethal skills to stay alive during an impossible mission. With the Berlin Wall about to fall, she travels into the heart of the city to retrieve a priceless dossier and take down a ruthless espionage ring. Once there, she teams up with an embedded station chief to navigate her way through the deadliest game of spies. (Action, Thriller, LGBTQ) - 2017

moremax.us.title: Spring Breakers
moremax.us.description: College students Candy (Vanessa Hudgens), Faith (Selena Gomez), Brit (Ashley Benson) and Cotty (Rachel Korine) are short of the cash they need for a spring-break trip, so they rob a diner and head down to Florida. However, the police soon break up the party and arrest them. The curvaceous quartet is unexpectedly bailed out by a drug dealer and aspiring rap artist named Alien (James Franco). Soon after, three of the four gal pals decide to join Alien in a life of crime. (Comedy, Crime drama) - 2012

moremax.us.title: Three Billboards Outside Ebbing, Missouri
moremax.us.description: After months have passed without a culprit in her daughter's murder case, Mildred Hayes makes a bold move, painting three signs leading into her town with a controversial message directed at William Willoughby, the town's revered chief of police. When his second-in-command, Officer Dixon -- an immature mother's boy with a penchant for violence -- gets involved, the battle is only exacerbated. (Crime drama, Dark comedy) - 2017

moremax.us.title: Aftermath
moremax.us.description: Two strangers' lives become inextricably bound together after an error by an air traffic controller (Scoot McNairy) causes the death of a construction foreman's (Arnold Schwarzenegger) wife and daughter. (Thriller, Drama, Action) - 2017

moremax.us.title: Mid90s
moremax.us.description: In the 1990s Los Angeles, a 13-year-old spends his summer navigating between a troubled home life and a crew of new friends he meets at a skate shop. (Comedy drama) - 2018

moremax.us.title: Hoot
moremax.us.description: Roy Eberhardt (Logan Lerman) has moved so often he has lost track of how many times he has changed schools. After moving from Montana to Florida's Gulf Coast, he befriends Beatrice (Brie Larson) and her brother. The siblings show Roy their hideaway, where they secretly take care of a flock of wild owls. When they learn that a restaurant will be built where the owls live, the three decide to enlist the help of a local policeman (Luke Wilson) to save the birds. (Children, Comedy, Adventure) - 2006

moremax.us.title: It's Kind of a Funny Story
moremax.us.description: Stressed by adolescence, 16-year-old Craig Gilner (Keir Gilchrist) checks himself into a mental-health clinic. Unfortunately, the youth wing is closed, so he must spend his mandated five-day stay with adults. One of them, Bobby (Zach Galifianakis), quickly becomes his mentor -- and protégé, while Craig finds himself drawn to a fellow teen, Noelle (Emma Roberts), who just may be the cure he needs to forget an unrequited crush. (Comedy drama) - 2010

moremax.us.title: The Switch
moremax.us.description: Neurotic Wally Mars has one bright spot in his life: his friendship with Kassie. When Kassie announces her intention to become pregnant using a sperm donor, Wally thinks he will be the lucky guy, but Kassie has someone else in mind. While drunk at Kassie's insemination party, Wally substitutes his sperm for the donor's, then passes out, remembering nothing. Seven years later, Wally meets Kassie's son, who seems oddly familiar to him. (Romantic comedy) - 2010

moremax.us.title: Game Night
moremax.us.description: Max and Annie's weekly game night gets kicked up a notch when Max's brother Brooks arranges a murder mystery party -- complete with fake thugs and federal agents. So when Brooks gets kidnapped, it's all supposed to be part of the game. As the competitors set out to solve the case, they start to learn that neither the game nor Brooks are what they seem to be. The friends soon find themselves in over their heads as each twist leads to another unexpected turn over the course of one chaotic night. (Comedy, Action) - 2018

moremax.us.title: A Good Day to Die Hard
moremax.us.description: New York City cop John McClane (Bruce Willis) arrives in Moscow to track down his estranged son, Jack (Jai Courtney). McClane thinks his son is a criminal, so it comes as a shock when he learns that Jack is actually working undercover to protect Komarov (Sebastian Koch), a Russian government whistleblower. With their own lives on the line, McClane and Jack must overcome their differences in order to get Komarov to safety and thwart a potentially disastrous crime in the Chernobyl region. (Action, Thriller) - 2013

moremax.us.title: The Transporter Refueled
moremax.us.description: Frank Martin is living a less perilous lifestyle, or so he thinks, transporting classified packages for questionable people. Things get complicated when femme fatale Anna and her three accomplices orchestrate a bank heist and the kidnapping of Frank's father. It's all part of a grand plan to take down the human trafficker who victimized her years earlier. Now a pawn in her vengeful scheme, the former special-operations mercenary must use his covert skills to play Anna's dangerous game. (Action, Thriller) - 2015

moremax.us.title: Scream
moremax.us.description: A psycho killer targets a past victim's daughter (Neve Campbell), while a tabloid TV reporter (Courteney Cox) homes in on his identity. - 1996

moremax.us.title: Us
moremax.us.description: A couple and their two children must fight for survival when four masked strangers descend upon their beachfront home. When the masks come off, the family is horrified to learn that each attacker takes the appearance of one of them. - 2019

moremax.us.title: The Nun
moremax.us.description: Vatican officials send a priest and a novitiate to investigate the suicide of a young nun in Romania. They soon find themselves in a fight for their lives when they encounter a demonic force that takes the shape of a nun. - 2018

moremax.us.title: Batman
moremax.us.description: The Caped Crusader (Michael Keaton) saves dismal Gotham City and gorgeous Vicki Vale (Kim Basinger) from the freaky Joker (Jack Nicholson). - 1989

moremax.us.title: Inconceivable
moremax.us.description: Angela develops a friendship with a mysterious woman named Katie and offers her a job as a live-in nanny. The natural bond soon turns into a dangerous obsession as Katie becomes overly attached to the family's young daughter. - 2017

moremax.us.title: 3 Days to Kill
moremax.us.description: A dying Secret Service agent (Kevin Costner) who wants to reconnect with his estranged daughter (Hailee Steinfeld) is offered a potentially lifesaving drug in exchange for completing one final mission. - 2014

moremax.us.title: Chasing Mavericks
moremax.us.description: Hearing that the mythic Mavericks surf break is real, a teenage surfer (Jonny Weston) asks a local legend (Gerard Butler) to teach him how to ride the wave and live to tell the tale. - 2012

moremax.us.description: Veterans of the 82nd Airborne Division devise an elaborate plot to simultaneously rob five casinos on New Year's Eve. - 1960

sbssydney.au.title: Classified
sbssydney.au.description: S2 E6 Proof Of Life Theo receives anonymous information about Rachel that catches his attention; the professional past shared between Denard and Rachel resurfaces and further confuses the issue.

sbssydney.au.title: Classified
sbssydney.au.description: S2 E7 Left Of Boom The management team now doubts Rachel after the latest trap set by Denard; shaken, Rachel distrusts those around her and carries out a highly dangerous operation.

sbssydney.au.title: Classified
sbssydney.au.description: S2 E8 Security Screening Rachel uncovers an accomplice of Denard; she discovers how he goes about always being one step ahead of her; Rachel asks Thomassin to cut ties with her uncle; Denard meets the leader of a drug cartel.

sbssydney.au.title: Classified
sbssydney.au.description: S2 E9 High-Level Orders Rachel negotiates with an accomplice of Denard and the hunt around the latter tightens; to save his colleague, one of the two hostages reveals all his secrets to the mercenaries.

sbssydney.au.title: Classified
sbssydney.au.description: S2 E10 Accountability A rescue operation is organised to free the hostages; Rachel puts in place the last levers of her own revenge while her rivalry with Denard intensifies when the latter attacks one of his relatives.

ABCMESydney.au.description: S3 E13 Fortune's Fools Mark's success with prospective ER interns leads to an offer of a tenured teaching position. The hospital suspends Carol after she admits her fatal mistake to a newspaper reporter. Carter decides to transfer to Hicks' team.

ABCMESydney.au.title: Mythbusters
ABCMESydney.au.description: S5 E24 Bullet Fired Vs. Bullet Dropped Adam and Jamie use gravity to test whether a bullet dropped from a height can catch up with one fired from a gun; experimenting to see whether it's possible to knock someone's socks off.

SBSWorldMoviesSydney.au.title: Knight of Cups
SBSWorldMoviesSydney.au.description: Rick is a slave to the Hollywood system. He is addicted to success but simultaneously despairs at the emptiness of his life. A screenwriter living in LA, he tries to make sense of the strange events occurring around him.

SBSWorldMoviesSydney.au.title: Girls Will Be Girls
SBSWorldMoviesSydney.au.description: In a strict boarding school nestled in the Himalayas, teenager Mira discovers desire and romance. However, Mira's mother, who never got to come of age herself, disrupts her rebellious sexual awakening.

SBSWorldMoviesSydney.au.title: The Movie Show
SBSWorldMoviesSydney.au.description: S6 E23 A review program hosted by Margaret Pomeranz and David Stratton featuring reviews and interviews from the movie world.

SBSWorldMoviesSydney.au.title: Above Us the Waves
SBSWorldMoviesSydney.au.description: Based on an actual incident in WWII, this tale follows the efforts of three naval officers to destroy the German battleship Tirpitz, which holds a seemingly impregnable position in a Norwegian fjord.

SBSWorldMoviesSydney.au.title: The Lunchbox
SBSWorldMoviesSydney.au.description: After her husband's homemade lunch is mistakenly delivered to someone else, a lonely housewife strikes up a friendship via letters with the recipient.

SBSWorldMoviesSydney.au.title: Hindi Vindi
SBSWorldMoviesSydney.au.description: A Sydney teenager bridges cultural gaps through music when he creatively fuses Australian hip-hop with traditional Hindi songs to connect with his beloved grandmother.

SBSWorldMoviesSydney.au.title: The Crow's Egg
SBSWorldMoviesSydney.au.description: Two boys from the Chennai slums constantly make demands on their family who do what they can to provide. A television inspires a shared dream between them, and they start developing schemes to make enough money to buy a pizza.

SBSWorldMoviesSydney.au.title: Broken Hill
SBSWorldMoviesSydney.au.description: A sheep rancher's son dreams of being accepted into the Sydney Conservatorium of Music. He has trouble finding an adequate band in the outback to perform his compositions, until he comes upon a talented prison choir.

SBSWorldMoviesSydney.au.title: Explorers
SBSWorldMoviesSydney.au.description: Three boys combine their talents and construct a homemade spaceship to launch themselves into another galaxy, where they meet some unusual aliens.

SBSWorldMoviesSydney.au.title: Thirteen Days
SBSWorldMoviesSydney.au.description: Details the Cuban missile crisis where, for 13 days in 1962, the US and the Soviet Union sit on the brink of full-scale nuclear war.

SBSWorldMoviesSydney.au.title: Out Standing
SBSWorldMoviesSydney.au.description: Officer Sandra Perron resigns from the Canadian military after a controversial photo surfaces. Adapting to civilian life amidst an investigation, she denies abuse allegations despite evidence suggesting mistreatment within her unit.

SBSWorldMoviesSydney.au.title: Ka Whawhai Tonu
SBSWorldMoviesSydney.au.description: In 1864 during the New Zealand Wars, Haki, a Māori-European teenager, fighting for the NZ colonial forces, is captured by the Māori resistance. He starts a reluctant friendship with Kopu, a young girl believed to be a medium for the Māori god of war.

SBSWorldMoviesSydney.au.title: Santosh
SBSWorldMoviesSydney.au.description: Santosh was 28 when her policeman husband died tragically. She inherits the position and in turn becomes a police officer.

SBSWorldMoviesSydney.au.title: The Arctic Convoy
SBSWorldMoviesSydney.au.description: In 1941, a convoy carrying vital military supplies to Allied Forces crosses treacherous, enemy-infested waters. The 35 civilian merchant ships brave brutal Arctic seas, fighting for their lives against German air and naval attacks.

SBSWorldMoviesSydney.au.title: Explorers
SBSWorldMoviesSydney.au.description: Three boys combine their talents and construct a homemade spaceship to launch themselves into another galaxy, where they meet some unusual aliens.

SBSWorldMoviesSydney.au.title: Mr. Holmes
SBSWorldMoviesSydney.au.description: Long-retired and near the end of his life, Sherlock Holmes grapples with an unreliable memory and must rely on his housekeeper's son as he revisits the still-unsolved case that led to his retirement.

SBSWorldMoviesSydney.au.title: Broken Hill
SBSWorldMoviesSydney.au.description: A sheep rancher's son dreams of being accepted into the Sydney Conservatorium of Music. He has trouble finding an adequate band in the outback to perform his compositions, until he comes upon a talented prison choir.

SBSWorldMoviesSydney.au.title: Like Water for Chocolate
SBSWorldMoviesSydney.au.description: When tradition keeps her from marrying her true love, the youngest daughter of a Mexican family expresses her feelings while preparing wonderful food.

SBSWorldMoviesSydney.au.title: The Arctic Convoy
SBSWorldMoviesSydney.au.description: In 1941, a convoy carrying vital military supplies to Allied Forces crosses treacherous, enemy-infested waters. The 35 civilian merchant ships brave brutal Arctic seas, fighting for their lives against German air and naval attacks.

SBSWorldMoviesSydney.au.description: Based on an actual incident in WWII, this tale follows the efforts of three naval officers to destroy the German battleship Tirpitz, which holds a seemingly impregnable position in a Norwegian fjord.

SBSWorldMoviesSydney.au.title: Whisky Galore!
SBSWorldMoviesSydney.au.description: Islanders off the coast of Scotland compete with a stuffy English commander to recover 50,000 cases of whisky from a wrecked cargo vessel.

SBSWorldMoviesSydney.au.title: The Skin of Others
SBSWorldMoviesSydney.au.description: A portrait of the life of Aboriginal man Douglas Grant, a WWI soldier, intellectual and journalist whose life helps explain the history of his country.

SBSWorldMoviesSydney.au.title: The Lighthorsemen
SBSWorldMoviesSydney.au.description: World War I Australian cavalrymen fight the Germans and the Turks, ending in a charge at Beersheba.

SBSWorldMoviesSydney.au.title: What We Do in the Shadows
SBSWorldMoviesSydney.au.description: Vampire housemates try to cope with the complexities of modern life and show a newly turned hipster some of the perks of being undead.

SBSWorldMoviesSydney.au.title: Dance First
SBSWorldMoviesSydney.au.description: Examines the life of Irish playwright Samuel Beckett, who was a World War II resistance fighter, Nobel Prize winner, philandering husband and recluse.

SBSWorldMoviesSydney.au.title: OBEX
SBSWorldMoviesSydney.au.description: Conor Marsh lives a secluded life with his dog, Sandy, until one day he begins playing OBEX, a new, state-of-the-art computer game.
