ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Ginger and the Vegesaurs
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E16 Pea Shooter The volcano is active which means the baby Pea-Rexes get to play Pea Shooter. Ginger manages to find her own way to join in.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Kangaroo Beach
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S3 E18 Whale Song Spectacular Gemma dreams of seeing a baby whale and the cadets help her throw a whale concert to attract their attention.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: HexVets And Magic Pets
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E29 Snug As A Bug Emilios causes trouble all day, and Annette only realizes why after he helps solve a case.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Mojo Swoptops
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E17 The Chickening Carrying a giant chicken to the country fair proves trickier than Mojo and Bo expected!

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Andy's Aquatic Adventures
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E23 Andy and the Storm Petrel There has been a big tropical storm at Safari World and Andy has made sure all the animals are safe and well. There is one nest he is not able to find: the nest of a storm petrel, which is a type of sea bird.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Play School
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: E18 Colours All Around: 3 Abi & Hunter experiment with mixing colours to make some crafty butterflies. They tell an under the sea story called Finding Bruno and they add blue to the 'wiggely woo line'.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Fireman Sam
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S16 E8 Over the Ledge When Peter lets Nipper off his lead after promising not to, Nipper runs away. Peter tries to get Nipper back but accidentally scares the dog off the edge of a cliff.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Zip And The Tiny Sprouts ᴺᵉʷ
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E44 Franken-Riff Riff starts giving her honest opinion and hurts her friends' feelings! Can she learn how to give feedback in a way that's kind?

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: The Woohoos!
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E19 Ellie's Cloud Ellie sees a funny grey cloud in the sky and the Woohoos wonder, is it grey because it's grumpy? After they observe it getting bigger and darker then seeming to cry, they work out that it's grey because it's a rain cloud.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Guess How Much I Love You
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E30 Four Seasons The cool Autumn breeze isn't enough to deter Little Nutbrown Hare and Little Field Mouse from going out to find what special experiences the day might bring.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Miffy and Friends ᴺᵉʷ
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E76 Miffy And The Games When Miffy discovers Melanie's father has won sports awards, she decides to turn their day of games into a grownup competition, to give Daddy a chance to do the same.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: The Sound Collector
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E39 Loud Music When the Sound Collector finds a studio, he remembers when he was in a band!

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Mittens & Pants
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S2 E42 Mummy Puppy Day When Pants joins his mum on her errand run, he expects more adventure and excitement. Instead, he learns that sometimes being responsible means it's not always play time.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: BeddyByes
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E44 Moth MeMo and BaBa find a moth and are surprised that it sleeps during the day and comes out to play at night. The Yummies find more ways to help the friends learn about nocturnal life.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Mini Kids
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S2 E6 Episode 6 The toddlers are visited by a snail. Fantus helps a little stork find its dad.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Bluey
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S2 E4 Squash When Dad and Uncle Stripe play a game of squash, Bluey and Bingo are in control of their every move, and Bingo proves that big siblings don't always beat little siblings.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Fizzy And Suds
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S3 E23 Dance 5, 6, 7, 8 - Fizzy and Suds bop through the world of dance, from hip hop and breakdancing to First Nations traditions and the rhythmic, dancing patterns of light.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Gardening Australia Junior
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S3 E17 Bird Paradise Millie, Maeve and Pia love birds. But what about the humble Ibis, or Bin Chicken? Millie loves them! They create a sanctuary for Ibises and other native birds and watch them enjoy their brand new Bird Paradise.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Ready, Steady, Wiggle!
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S4 E22 Five Finger Family Join The Wiggles and sing along with the classic nursery rhyme 'Five Finger Family', then it's off to visit the Wiggle Town Dancing Water Police to solve the mystery of the missing ballet shoe.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Iron Man and His Awesome Friends
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E10 Ironheart's Awesome Playground Riri's playground plans are bugged by Swarm's power-draining robo-mosquitoes.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Mecha Builders
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E51 Sticky Space Race When super sticky slime spills on Zee and MacBarm, the Mechas have to figure out how to pull them apart.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Thomas & Friends
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S24 E20 Thomas' Animal Friends When Thomas finds out that the Earl's Technology Fair will bring new inventions to Sodor, he sets out to prove that steam engines are the best inventions ever.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Peppa Pig
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S5 E41 Grampy Rabbit's Hovercraft Grampy Rabbit saves the day when Grandpa Pig's boat sinks and drives everyone around on his Hovercraft!

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Peppa Pig
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S5 E42 Playgroup Star Peppa gets her very first Playgroup Star in school for drawing a wonderful picture of her house!

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Shaun the Sheep
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S5 E19 Shaun Shoots The Sheep Shaun finds a camera which some ramblers have dropped, and sets about taking snapshots of the flock - but Bitzer is soon on the trail of the missing camera.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Ginger and the Vegesaurs
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E14 Lost Ginger and the baby Pea-Rexes search for honeysuckles, leaving behind a trail of berries to help find their way back. But when Wasabi eats the trail, they're stranded in the dark!

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Ben & Holly's Little Kingdom
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E40 Camping Out Holly is going on a camping trip with Ben and his mum and dad, but they are soon joined by annoying Mr Gnome, who is always hungry and sings silly songs.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Flower & Flour
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E31 Oogga Sugga Flower rediscovers her magical Oogga Sugga straw and tries it out on Dad, but it breaks! With Flour's help, she repairs it, finally spreading Oogga Sugga fun to Dirk, Penny, and even herself.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Superkitties
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S2 E13 Seed Stealer The SuperKitties teach Zsa-Zsa that if she takes care of planted seeds, they'll grow into fruits and veggies for everyone to enjoy.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Santiago of the Seas
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S2 E32 The Ocelot's Tale A fun sleepover in Larimar's Museum turns into an adventure when one of the pieces of art comes to life.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: PJ Masks: Power Heroes
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E45 Flashcar To The Moon Catboy wants to prove himself a fast driver so powers his cat racer with a moon crystal and blasts into space.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: The Octonauts
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S3 E9 The Octonauts and the Duck-Billed Platypus While rescuing river creatures after a storm, the Octonauts find a strange egg.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Hey Duggee
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E26 The Hide and Seek Badge The dog and the squirrels decide to play hide and seek and Duggee finds them all except Roly.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Kangaroo Beach
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S3 E18 Whale Song Spectacular Gemma dreams of seeing a baby whale and the cadets help her throw a whale concert to attract their attention.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Fireman Sam
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S14 E22 Baking Blunder The Pontypandy Pioneers bake up a storm to earn their baking badge, but when a greasy oven bursts into flames, it's time to call the rescue team!

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Nikhil & Jay
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E37 Nikhil and Jay and the Dream Detectives When Nikhil wakes up, he misses the end of his amazing dream! Jay tries lots of ways to help him find the ending so they can tell it at their 'share a story' picnic.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Numberblocks
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E83 Thirty's Big Top Welcome to the Big Top, where Thirty and friends show off their circus tricks.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Monster Makes
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E18 Out of this World! Space inspires Murphi and Rebecca's creations, including an alien made from a sock. Some cotton wool helps cardboard tubes become a space rocket. Is the attic ready for lift off?

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Mittens & Pants
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S2 E28 Pool Party Pants and Popcorn know just how to beat the heat, with a pool party! They invite everyone over, but playing in the water isn't something their friends do.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Play School: Rainforest Rangers
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S376 E3 Plants of the Rainforest Rangers Zindzi and Takaya explore all the fascinating plants you find in the rainforest! They create a rainforest terrarium, make a yummy avocado snack, and find out how different rainforest plants live and grow together!

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: The Wiggles: Wiggle and Learn ᴺᵉʷ
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S2 E18 Episode 18 Lachy is gardening today with his beautiful apple tree! Simon helps by digging a hole in the ground and finds a story to read to us all! A story all about the Tree of Wisdom!

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Fizzy And Suds
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S2 E20 Tractors Fizzy and Suds ride tractors of all sizes! They watch huge wheels, harvest wheat in neat rows, and see a tractor pull a stuck vehicle out of mud - a mighty tractor rescue on the farm!

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: L'il Stompers ᴺᵉʷ
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E43 L'il Super Stompers Breezy and Chase play at being heroic Super Stompers, and rescue Simone and DeeDee. But when Simone and DeeDee want to have a turn, Breezy and Chase ignore them, leaving DeeDee and Simone to find their own thing to do.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Ginger and the Vegesaurs
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S4 E17 Mammoth Problem Ginger and the Peas go ice skating with some furry friends during winter.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Gardening Australia Junior
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S3 E28 Bonza Bonsai The junior gardeners visit the Arboretum in Canberra and learn all about the mindful art of Bonsai.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Andy's Wild Workouts
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E8 Up In The Air Andy is up in the air on his latest adventure and he wants you to come along too. He meets spectacular birds like the fantail and hummingbird but also the unusual atlas moth and learns to move just like them.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Santiago of the Seas
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S2 E58 Bonnie's Bones Bonnie must steal an epic treasure to receive a family heirloom, but she keeps getting thwarted by the Pirate Protectors!

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Superkitties
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E6 Fufu Snafu The SuperKitties have to stop Cat Burglar after he takes a gold statue from the Kittydale Museum.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Hey Duggee
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S3 E7 The Pen Pal Badge The arrival of the Delivery Stork brings letters from the Squirrels' Pen Pals - children in other countries all over the world that the Squirrels have been writing to!

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Bluey
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E4 Daddy Robot Bluey and Bingo don't want to tidy the playroom, so they get Daddy Robot to do it for them. But when Bluey takes things too far, Daddy Robot malfunctions with disastrous results.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Peppa Pig
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S11 E29 Beaver Dam Today, Mr Beaver is teaching everyone how to build a dam! During this Peppa and Suzy accidentally overwhelm Bobby. After they apologise, Bobby tells them about where the fairies are.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Peppa Pig
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S9 E56 Dinosaur Party! Peppa and George have come to play at Granny and Grandpa's house. Grandpa Pig comes to meet them at the front door.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Kiri and Lou
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S2 E32 Mighty Forest Lou shows Kiri the tree he's planted, and she's jealous and steals one of his seeds.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Big Lizard
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E14 How to Record Sound Big Lizard accidentally deletes some of Dad's \.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: The Octonauts
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E33 The Octonauts And The Combtooth Blenny When Kwazii and Peso are shipwrecked on a desert island, they encounter a Combtooth Blenny - a fish who walks on land! They enlist him to send an SOS message to the other Octonauts.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Kangaroo Beach
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E7 Sandy's Surf School When Neville fails to learn how to surf as well as his friends, he builds a self-surfing surfboard - but it quickly lands him in hot water.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Super Monsters
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S3 E1 Moonlight Melody Lobo and Spike learn the power of teamwork and embracing uniqueness in magical adventures filled with lessons on friendship and overcoming challenges.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Spidey and His Amazing Friends ᴺᵉʷ
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S2 E27 Pirate Plunder Blunder Team Spidey must save Aunt May when Green Goblin's device makes people think they're pirates.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Bluey
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E5 Shadowlands On a picnic in the park, Bluey and her friends play Shadowlands. But when Coco keeps taking shortcuts, Bluey has to show her that following the rules can make the game more fun.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Flower & Flour
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E14 Neha's Writer's Block Neha can't think of a poem for Open Mic Night at the restaurant, so Flower and Flour take her around the plaza for inspiration.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Ben & Holly's Little Kingdom
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S2 E33 The Dwarf Mine Strange holes are appearing throughout the Little Kingdom. It's the Dwarves, deep underground, digging for treasure! A solution must be found before the Dwarves dig up everything.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Piripenguins
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E13 Flutter's Honour Pancake saves Flutter who vows to repay him, but his behaviour drives Pan to distraction.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Supertato
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S2 E17 Three Peas in a Pod The Tato Team are playing beach volleyball. But when Evil Pea's parents, Mummy Pea and Daddy Pea, pay her a visit, they are disappointed to learn that she doesn't rule the supermarket!

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Batwheels
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S2 E14 The Gotham Guardians Bam must lead a new super vehicle team consisting of Nightbike, Goldie, Grundy, and Kitty after the Legion of Zoom traps the rest of the Batwheels in the Batcave.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Bluey
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S2 E5 Hairdressers During a game of hairdressers, Bluey discovers that big-headed customer Dad has nits! To help treat them Bingo has to find her voice, while Bluey has to find her ears.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Shaun the Sheep
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S4 E11 The Looney Tic Everyone is settling down for the night, when Bitzer begins to act strangely - he just can't sit still. When his peculiar behaviour starts spreading around the Flock, Shaun decides he must find out what's causing it.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Ninjago ᴺᵉʷ
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S6 E3 Enkrypted Falsely imprisoned, the Ninja are at their lowest point, but find an unlikely friend in an old enemy. Meanwhile, Nadakhan rescues his marooned crew and gains a new perspective, along with a new mysterious plan.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Young Sheldon
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S6 E15 Teen Angst and a Smart-Boy Walk of Shame Sheldon confronts the failure of his database; Georgie and Mandy struggle as new parents; Missy feels forgotten.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: BtN Newsbreak ᴺᵉʷ
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: E201 Episode 201 Find out what's going on in the world with a news bulletin designed for children, featuring stories that are relevant and easy to understand.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Young Sheldon
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S6 E16 A Stolen Truck and Going on the Lam Missy steals her dad's truck and hits the road with her friend Paige.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Animal Park ᴺᵉʷ
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S19 E15 Episode 15 Have the park's vultures laid their first successful egg in ten years?

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Recipe of the Year
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E3 Episode 3 From backyard get-togethers to milestone birthdays and everything in between, today our home cooks celebrate the recipes that bring people together.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Merlin
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S2 E4 Lancelot and Guinevere When Gwen is kidnapped Arthur defies the King to go to her rescue, but someone else gets there first: Lancelot.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Fresh Off the Boat
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S4 E6 A League of Her Own Fearful of disappointing her father, Nicole struggles with telling Marvin after coming out as a lesbian to Honey and Jessica. Meanwhile, chaos ensues when Jessica and Louis go head-to-head in a softball tournament.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Young Sheldon
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S6 E12 A Baby Shower and a Testosterone-Rich Banter Mary butts heads with Mandy's mother, and Sheldon attempts male bonding.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Pokemon: Ruby and Sapphire
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S7 E27 Go Go Ludicolo! Ash's Corphish is having a hard time with all the attention given to the newly evolved Grovyle.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Dragon Ball Super
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S5 E38 Universe 6's Most Powerful Warrior! Meet Hit Man Hit!! Vegeta goes up against the last member of the 6th Universe, the assassin Hit! With movements so fast nobody can even see him, Hit proves to be a true match for Vegeta. Will the prince of Saiyans finally fall?

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Miraculous: Tales Of Ladybug And Cat Noir
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S4 E2 Lies A friend of Adrien's gets akumatized into Lies. Able to make liars disappear, she is determined to rid the world of lies and those who tell them... including superheroes!

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: We Bare Bears
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S2 E14 Lucy's Brother To impress Lucy, Panda offers to babysit her brother, Clifford. But Clifford turns out to be too high maintenance for Panda to handle.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: We Bare Bears
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S3 E28 Rescue Ranger Tabes helps the Bears rescue Charlie.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Teen Titans Go!
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S2 E25 Mouth Hole Robin goes on a quest to gain a new power: whistling.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Teen Titans Go!
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S6 E2 Tv Knight 5 Batman pretends to be sick to avoid work - so he and Commissioner Gordon can run around town, watching their favourite TV shows.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Teen Titans Go!
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S7 E11 Space House - Part 4 The free holiday in space was just an elaborate plot by Brainiac to round up every hero and villain in the DC Multiverse. The Titans and Superhero Girls agree to help Brainiac grow up in exchange for letting them go.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Total Dramarama
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S2 E22 Dream Worriers Izzy forgets the ending to her most amazing dream of all time, so the kids travel into her mind to find out what happened.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: The Powerpuff Girls
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E14 Puffdora's Box Blossom gets overzealous with spring cleaning.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S20 E4 Arc of Infinity: Part 4 Omega has been reborn in Amsterdam in the Doctor's form, but the transference hasn’t worked. The Doctor pursues him through the city, aware Omega is now a walking anti-matter bomb.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S20 E5 Snakedance: Part 1 The Mara is returning home, to the planet Manussa, five hundred years after being exiled. And it is using Tegan's subconscious to get there in the TARDIS.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S20 E6 Snakedance: Part 2 As Tegan tries to rid her mind of the Mara forever, the Doctor learns about the Little Mind’s Eye crystal, while coping with the local politics of the Federator.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S20 E7 Snakedance: Part 3 As Tegan and Lon combine to give the Mara access back to reality, the Doctor locates the Great Mind’s Eye crystal but realises it is instrumental in the Mara's plan.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S20 E8 Snakedance: Part 4 The Doctor and the original snakedancer Dojeen work to rid the planet of the malign Mara once and for all, but it has the whole of Manussa in its psychic grip now.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S20 E9 Mawdryn Undead: Part 1 Caught in a warp ellipse, the TARDIS is drawn to a huge spacecraft orbiting Earth whereupon the Doctor is separated in space and time from Nyssa and Tegan.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S18 E2 The Leisure Hive: Part 2 The Tachyon Recreation Generator is the cause of the mysterious deaths at the Leisure Hive. Romana makes repairs, and the Doctor becomes a reluctant guinea pig.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S18 E3 The Leisure Hive: Part 3 The Tachyon Generator has aged the Doctor into a white haired old man, but he discovers the truth behind the machine and uncovers a plot to take control of the Hive.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S19 E22 Earthshock: Part 4 The Doctor realises the freighter is now a huge bomb, with one passenger still aboard...

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S19 E23 Time-Flight: Part 1 When a Speedbird Concorde disappears back through a crack in time, the Doctor takes another Concorde to follow its trail, unaware that a mysterious conjuror, Kalid, waits for him.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S19 E24 Time-Flight: Part 2 After an encounter with the Plasmatons, Nyssa is possessed by strange aliens while the Doctor, joined by Professor Hayter investigates Kalid’s inner sanctum.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S19 E25 Time-Flight: Part 3 From within their sarcophagus, the gestalt Xeraphin are communicating through Nyssa, but their psychic energy is so powerful, it may destroy her body completely.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S19 E26 Time-Flight: Part 4 The Master’s TARDIS is repaired and the Doctor must follow him back to 20th century Heathrow, once he has rescued all the passengers and crew from both Concordes.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S20 E1 Arc of Infinity: Part 1 On Gallifrey the Doctor has been chosen, during a clandestine meeting, to be used to perpetrate a terrible act. Unaware, the Doctor and Nyssa trace something odd to Amsterdam.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S20 E2 Arc of Infinity: Part 2 Commander Maxil doesn’t believe the Doctor is innocent and reckons the easiest way to stop the evil being reborn on Gallifrey would be to kill him before the bonding can occur.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S20 E11 Mawdryn Undead: Part 3 Mawdryn and his eternal mutants are awake and reveal the truth, they are exiles, they are in pain and need something only the Doctor can give them. His future lives.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S20 E13 Terminus: Part 1 Turlough sabotages the TARDIS causing it to fuse with the space station Terminus. Trying to separate the two, the Doctor encounters a couple of space pirates.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S20 E14 Terminus: Part 2 While the other Vanir sought out their hydromel, the curious Bor took a journey to try and solve the mystery at the heart of Terminus itself. And now he knows the secrets….

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S20 E15 Terminus: Part 3 Trapped with the Lazars, Nyssa to find a way to help them, while the Doctor and Kari find the original pilot of Terminus and realise his mistake is about to be repeated...

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S20 E16 Terminus: Part 4 The Garm and the pirates stop Terminus setting off a second Big Bang, while the Vanir fight between themselves for their future. Meanwhile Nyssa makes a monumental decision...

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S20 E17 Enlightenment: Part 1 The TARDIS’s power is drained away just as the Doctor receives a dire warning from the White Guardian, and before long finds himself drawn into a strange race throgh the stars.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S20 E18 Enlightenment: Part 2 While Tegan has to cope with the unwelcome attention of Marriner, the Doctor realises that Striker and his officers are Eternals and that the human crew mean nothing to them.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S20 E19 Enlightenment: Part 3 Captain Wrack manipulates Turlough, because she is also working for the Black Guardian and during an Eternals party she places a bomb aboard Striker’s ship.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S20 E20 Enlightenment: Part 4 The race for the Enlightenment is over and a winner has been crowned. But Turlough must make a decision and it’s one the Doctor and Tegan cannot help him with.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Strait To The Plate

nbcuniverso.us.title: Escape perfecto - Ánimo para ganar
nbcuniverso.us.description: Las hermanas Wendy e Itzel creen tener todo para llevarse el dinero en efectivo. Jorge y Carolina, esposos, llegan con mucha energía para ganar una recámara infantil para sus hijos. (Game Shows, Performing Arts)

nbcuniverso.us.title: Escape perfecto - Nerviosos para ganar
nbcuniverso.us.description: Luis y José se han preparado física y mentalmente para ganar un viaje a Cancún. Roberto y Nancy van por un auto. Por su parte, Eduardo y Eva quieren multiplicar sus premios al doble. (Game Shows, Performing Arts)

nbcuniverso.us.title: Caso cerrado - La imperfección; Golpeada por español
nbcuniverso.us.description: La hija de Antonio y Yelitza sufre bullying en su escuela por la apariencia física de su padre. Por otro lado, Alexandra es discriminada y hasta violentada en su trabajo por hablar español. (Reality TV, Legal)

nbcuniverso.us.title: Caso cerrado - Bebé en depósito; El esquizofrénico
nbcuniverso.us.description: Erlin y su pareja rechazan adoptar a un niño con un padecimiento óseo que le condicionará la vida. Melvin es demandado por ser cómplice del suicidio de su cuñado, quien era esquizofrénico. (Reality TV, Legal)

nbcuniverso.us.title: Caso cerrado - Traición pornoson; En el nombre del padre y de los hijos
nbcuniverso.us.description: Lo contrataron para una fiesta religiosa y cantó salsa con letras sexualmente explícitas. Catalina quiere visitar a su padre que agoniza, pero él la violó y existe una orden de alejamiento. (Reality TV, Legal)

nbcuniverso.us.title: Historias de la Virgen morena - La bruja de la cuadra
nbcuniverso.us.description: Marcela pierde a su esposo y a su hija en un accidente automovilístico. El dolor la sume en una enorme amargura y, por eso, le dicen bruja. (Religious, Drama)

nbcuniverso.us.title: Historias de la Virgen morena - La felicidad no se compra
nbcuniverso.us.description: Al perder a su padre, Ariadna y su familia quedan en la ruina lo que provoca un completo cambio en su vida. Una oportunidad para aprender que la felicidad no se compra con dinero. (Religious, Drama)

nbcuniverso.us.title: Lo que callamos las mujeres - Yolanda, amor clandestino
nbcuniverso.us.description: Al comenzar una relación con Clemente, su profesor y padre de su mejor amiga, Yolanda termina embarazada. Tras 25 años de matrimonio, él lo abandona todo por ella sin medir las consecuencias. (Drama, Soaps)

nbcuniverso.us.title: El final del paraíso - La pelea final
nbcuniverso.us.description: La Cuina, la Tonina y Pilar caen en una trampa. Por otro lado, Catalina no entregará a su nieta porque cree que el futuro con Mariana es oscuro. (Soaps, Drama)

nbcuniverso.us.title: Lo que callamos las mujeres - Silvia: Sin filtros
nbcuniverso.us.description: Silvia desarrolla dismorfia corporal y su madre quiere resolver el asunto con una cirugía; un consejo la hace reflexionar y la joven inicia el tratamiento psicológico para aceptarse como es. (Drama, Soaps)

nbcuniverso.us.title: Un día para vivir - Comida familiar
nbcuniverso.us.description: Raúl cree que ha dejado atrás un pasado oscuro, pero sus acciones dejaron huella y ahora tiene que cruzarse con una extraña familia para poder resolverlo, sin imaginar la sorpresa que le espera. (Soaps, Drama)

nbcuniverso.us.title: Acércate a Rocío
nbcuniverso.us.description: Hablar de los problemas es el primer paso para superarlos y, por eso, Rocío trae un programa único para hablar de las preocupaciones de cada día y, en conjunto, encontrar una solución. (Talk Shows, Lifestyle)

nbcuniverso.us.title: Caso cerrado - Los fluidos: Cola de sirena
nbcuniverso.us.description: Camilo quiere romper la sociedad que tiene con Sofí­a en un gimnasio, porque los clientes se quejan del mal olor de la madre de ella. La hija de Marcela casi se ahoga con una cola de sirena. (Reality TV, Legal)

nbcuniverso.us.title: El final del paraíso - El canje

nbcuniverso.us.title: Caso cerrado - Traición de hermana; Se me quemó la Navidad
nbcuniverso.us.description: Fue secuestrada y obligada a prostituirse, está segura de que su hermana estuvo detrás de todo. En uno de sus apartamentos vive la madre de un amigo, la señora le prendió fuego por accidente. (Reality TV, Legal)

oxygenwest.us.title: Homicide for the Holidays
oxygenwest.us.description: S01 E02 Christmas Carnage in Carnation The holiday season screeches to a halt when six members of the Anderson family are discovered to have been gunned down in their home; detectives work closely with family friends to track down the shocking murderer.

oxygenwest.us.title: Homicide for the Holidays

oxygenwest.us.title: Homicide for the Holidays
oxygenwest.us.description: S01 E04 A Christmas Morning Murder A holiday is ruined when a couple is gunned down in their bed during what looks like a brutal home invasion, but police soon discover the true motive for the double homicide is a shocking tale of deception and betrayal.

oxygenwest.us.title: Homicide for the Holidays
oxygenwest.us.description: S02 E02 Holiday Terror Firefighters respond to a house fire and discover three gunshot victims inside; authorities pursue the heavily armed murderer through Christmas.

oxygenwest.us.title: Homicide for the Holidays
oxygenwest.us.description: S02 E03 Christmas Mourning On Christmas Eve in a quiet town, elderly couple Bob and Idella Young are brutally slain at home; a bloody glove found at the crime scene has the killer's DNA, but no one matches the sample.

oxygenwest.us.title: Snapped

wdrb.us.title: The Simpsons
wdrb.us.description: This long-running animated comedy focuses on the eponymous family in the town of Springfield in an unnamed U.S. state. The head of the Simpson family, Homer, is not a typical family man. A nuclear-plant employee, he does his best to lead his family but often finds that they are leading him. The family includes loving, blue-haired matriarch Marge, troublemaking son Bart, overachieving daughter Lisa and baby Maggie. Other Springfield residents include the family's religious neighbor, Ned Flanders, family physician Dr. Hibbert, Moe the bartender and police chief Clancy Wiggum. (Animated, Sitcom) - 1989-12-17

wdrb.us.title: Young Sheldon
wdrb.us.description: For young Sheldon Cooper, it isn't easy growing up in East Texas. Being a once-in-a-generation mind capable of advanced mathematics and science isn't always helpful in a land where church and football are king. And while the vulnerable, gifted and somewhat naive Sheldon deals with the world, his very normal family must find a way to deal with him. His father, George, is struggling to find his way as a high school football coach and as father to a boy he doesn't understand. Sheldon's mother, Mary, fiercely protects and nurtures her son. For 12 years on "The Big Bang Theory," audiences came to know the iconic, eccentric and extraordinary Sheldon Cooper. In "Young Sheldon," audiences get a chance to meet him in childhood, as he embarks on his innocent, awkward and hopeful journey toward the man he will become. Jim Parsons, who plays the adult version of Sheldon on "The Big Bang Theory," narrates. (Sitcom) - 2017-09-25

discoverywest.us.title: Louisiana Law : Monster Crabber
discoverywest.us.description: S01 E01 Deep in the woods and bayous of Louisiana, wildlife agents protect the state's resources; a crab fisherman is caught stealing dozens of traps, a hunter crosses state lines with an illegal deer and agents rescue an injured bald eagle.

discoverywest.us.title: Louisiana Law : Mr. Bad Guy
discoverywest.us.description: S01 E03 In southern Louisiana, Lt. David Nunez and Sgt. Austin Arteaga investigate a group of bird hunters on opening day of teal season; a repeated offender is busted for taking immature crabs; a late-night deer decoy leads to a hunter in handcuffs.

discoverywest.us.title: Louisiana Law : Road Killer
discoverywest.us.description: S01 E02 In Jackson Parish, a reckless hunter is investigated for shooting down a highway; agents stake out a man suspected of two illegal deer kills; duck hunters are confronted for harassment; a crowded boat parade ends with citations.

discoverywest.us.title: Secret Life of a Vegas Casino
discoverywest.us.description: S01 E04 Nightmare on Fremont Street A rookie security manager on his first graveyard shift struggles to keep up with an escalating barrage of bizarre calls, ringing one after another; meanwhile, a late-night VIP pickup turns into a cross-town odyssey full of unexpected detours.

discoverywest.us.title: Secret Life of a Vegas Casino
discoverywest.us.description: S01 E03 Sex, Lies and Surveillance Tape A hotel guest reports a theft that launches an investigation with security and Metro detectives, but the truth proves to be far more scandalous.

discoverywest.us.title: Secret Life of a Vegas Casino
discoverywest.us.description: S01 E02 Big Bang Theories Reports of loud bangs and bullet holes on the eighth floor spark a tense night before the cause of the chaos is discovered one floor above.

discoverywest.us.title: Secret Life of a Vegas Casino
discoverywest.us.description: S01 E01 The Good, the Bad and the Unlucky As the Golden Nugget's busiest season begins, tempers flare at check-in; a swiped $1,000 chip sparks a hotel-wide high-tech hunt; surveillance targets a team of card counters; and a VIP host gets creative to keep his client gambling.

discoverywest.us.title: Secret Life of a Vegas Casino
discoverywest.us.description: S01 E05 Till Death Do Us Shark Four unique weddings in one day stretch the Golden Nugget's wedding team to their limit; a crack in the 200,000-gallon shark tank raises the alarm; stolen casino keys cause chaos; security breaks up a rowdy wedding party of seniors.

discoverywest.us.title: Contraband: Seized at the Border
discoverywest.us.description: S09 E08 Just Doing My Duty Each year, CBP recovers over 1,300 stolen vehicles at ports of entry. Many are heading to the black market, while cartels use others for trafficking. When officers receive a be on the lookout (BOLO) alert for a luxury car, they take it seriously.

discoverywest.us.title: Contraband: Seized at the Border
discoverywest.us.description: S09 E01 Tramadol to Hell A driver claims he buys used cars over the border to import into the U.S., but an X-ray reveals something hidden in his spare tire; when a traveler returning from Mexico declares snacks at customs, a fish and wildlife expert is called in.

discoverywest.us.title: Contraband: Seized at the Border
discoverywest.us.description: S09 E04 The Meth Doesn't Add Up During his first day on the job, a rookie officer relies on his training, sending a hesitant driver for further inspection, and his hunch pays off; when a traveler claims to be visiting his dentist bimonthly in Mexico, officers investigate further.

discoverywest.us.title: Contraband: Seized at the Border
discoverywest.us.description: S09 E05 Roses in Red, Violence in Blue A traveler is caught with blades for cockfighting, a cartel-run blood sport; every year, Mexico grows millions of dollars of flowers for the U.S., but cartels are taking advantage of the influx of shipments during major holidays.

discoverywest.us.title: Contraband: Seized at the Border
discoverywest.us.description: S09 E03 The Breeder's Cup Officers find an 18-wheeler carrying more than a load of takeout containers; a couple raises suspicion after declaring bulldog semen, but the labeling suggests the box may actually contain stallion semen, a valuable and tightly regulated substance.

discoverywest.us.title: All Access PD: Grand Rapids ᴺᵉʷ
discoverywest.us.description: S01 E04 Cemetery What seemed like an accidental overdose becomes a murder investigation when a jail informant tips off Grand Rapids detectives; conflicting witness accounts leave the detectives searching for hard evidence to solve Dana's death.

discoverywest.us.title: 120 Hours Behind Bars
discoverywest.us.description: S02 E02 Tangipahoa Parish Jail In Bloody Tangipahoa, a new sheriff takes on a parish defined by violence, fighting to pull a crumbling, neglected jail back from the brink while inmates work to rebuild the family bonds that could keep them from coming back.

discoverywest.us.title: 120 Hours Behind Bars
discoverywest.us.description: S01 E08 Washoe County Jail Inside one of Nevada's busiest jails, deputies battle a non-stop surge of arrests driven by Reno's constant crime and a major trafficking corridor; with gangs entrenched inside, keeping rival groups apart becomes a daily fight for control.

fxm.us.title: All About Eve
fxm.us.description: Backstage story revolving around aspiring actress Eve Harrington. Tattered and forlorn, Eve shows up in the dressing room of Broadway mega-star Margo Channing, telling a melancholy life story to Margo and her friends. Margo takes Eve under her wing, and it appears that Eve is a conniver that uses Margo. (Drama) - 1950

fxm.us.title: My Friend Flicka
fxm.us.description: Ken McLaughlin (Roddy McDowall) is a precocious 10-year-old who lives with his family on a remote Wyoming ranch. When Ken returns home from school with failing grades, his father, Rob (Preston Foster), blames the boy's lack of personal responsibility. At the suggestion of his wife, Nell (Rita Johnson), Rob allows Ken to choose a single colt from the herd to raise as his own. Much to his father's dismay, Ken chooses a fiery mustang filly -- but the two soon become fast friends. (Children, Drama) - 1943

fxm.us.title: Curly Top
fxm.us.description: Charming, headstrong young Elizabeth Blair (Shirley Temple) lives at the Lakeside Orphanage where her sister, Mary (Rochelle Hudson), works in the kitchen. Mary writes songs that Elizabeth sings. The child's performance and her spirit impress a young, wealthy trustee, Edward Morgan (John Boles), who poses as a lawyer with an offer of adoption for Elizabeth, but she won't leave without her sister. Edward decides to bring them both to his mansion, and soon begins to fall in love with Mary. (Musical) - 1935

fxm.us.title: A Journal for Jordan
fxm.us.description: Deployed to Iraq, First Sgt. Charles Monroe King starts to keep a journal of love and advice for his infant son. Back at home, Dana Canedy, a senior editor for The New York Times, revisits the story of her unlikely, life-altering relationship with King and his enduring devotion to his beloved family. (Drama, Romance) - 2021

fxm.us.title: West Side Story
fxm.us.description: Love at first sight strikes when young Tony spots Maria at a high school dance in 1957 New York City. Their burgeoning romance helps to fuel the fire between the warring Jets and Sharks -- two rival gangs vying for control of the streets. (Musical, Romance) - 2021

fxm.us.title: The Egyptian
fxm.us.description: In ancient Egypt, Sinuhe (Edmund Purdom) is a would-be doctor who saves the life of a young man (Michael Wilding) suffering from a seizure. When the afflicted youth awakes, he introduces himself as the Pharaoh Akhnaton and makes Sinuhe the royal healer. While working at his new, prestigious post, Sinuhe suffers through a botched romance and the death of his adoptive parents. Despondent, he leaves the Pharaoh's court to bury his loved ones, and, in the process, incurs the wrath of Akhnaton. (Historical drama) - 1954

fxm.us.title: Cleopatra
fxm.us.description: "Cleopatra" is a lengthy, sprawling, spectacular love story, helmed by Joseph L. Mankiewicz, depicting Cleopatra's manipulation of Julius Caesar and Marc Antony in her ill-fated attempt to save the Egyptian empire. This threesome in one of the most famous and gloriously powerful love triangles ever to be captured on film. (Historical drama) - 1963

fxm.us.title: Tolkien
fxm.us.description: As a young student, J.R.R. Tolkien finds love, friendship and artistic inspiration among a group of fellow outcasts. Their brotherhood soon strengthens as Tolkien weathers the storm of a tumultuous courtship with Edith Bratt and the outbreak of World War I. These early life experiences later inspire the budding author to write the classic fantasy novels The Hobbit and The Lord of the Rings. (Biography, Historical drama) - 2019

5starmax.us.title: Book of Shadows: Blair Witch 2
5starmax.us.description: As it follows the twisted path traveled by five people fixated on "The Blair Witch Project," "Book of Shadows: Blair Witch 2" journeys into a dark and dangerous place where the line between truth and fiction blurs and perhaps vanishes altogether. Individual perception grows increasingly untrustworthy as the film's protagonists find themselves caught in a vortex of unspeakable evil, the origins of which -- human or supernatural -- remain chillingly uncertain. (Adventure, Fantasy, Horror) - 2000

5starmax.us.title: Blood Simple
5starmax.us.description: "Blood Simple" was the first feature film from Joel and Ethan Coen. This is the newly restored and re-edited director's cut of the film, introduced by Mortimer Young. The stylish crime thriller premiered at film festivals in 1984. "Blood Simple" begins deep in the heart of Texas, where a jealous saloon owner hires a cheap divorce detective to kill the saloon owner's younger wife and her bartender lover. But the detective gets a better idea. (Thriller, Crime drama) - 1984

5starmax.us.title: Lord of the Flies
5starmax.us.description: Amidst a nuclear war, a plane carrying a group of schoolboys crash lands on a deserted island. With no adult survivors, the boys are forced to fend for themselves. At first, they cooperate, but when they split into two separate camps -- one led by the pragmatic Ralph (James Aubrey) and the other by militaristic Jack (Tom Chapin) -- their society falls into disarray, leading to a disturbing examination of human nature and a chilling conclusion. (Drama, Adventure, Thriller) - 1963

5starmax.us.title: Enter Nowhere
5starmax.us.description: Three strangers arrive one at a time in a remote cabin, and learn they have been brought together for a reason. (Drama, Horror, Mystery, Thriller) - 2011

5starmax.us.title: Batman
5starmax.us.description: Having witnessed his parents' brutal murder as a child, millionaire philanthropist Bruce Wayne (Michael Keaton) fights crime in Gotham City disguised as Batman, a costumed hero who strikes fear into the hearts of villains. But when a deformed madman who calls himself The Joker (Jack Nicholson) seizes control of Gotham's criminal underworld, Batman must face his most ruthless nemesis ever while protecting both his identity and his love interest, reporter Vicki Vale (Kim Basinger). (Action, Adventure, Fantasy) - 1989

5starmax.us.title: Batman Returns
5starmax.us.description: The monstrous Penguin (Danny DeVito), who lives in the sewers beneath Gotham, joins up with wicked shock-headed businessman Max Shreck (Christopher Walken) to topple the Batman (Michael Keaton) once and for all. But when Shreck's timid assistant, Selina Kyle (Michelle Pfeiffer), finds out, and Shreck tries to kill her, she is transformed into the sexy Catwoman. She teams up with the Penguin and Shreck to destroy Batman, but sparks fly unexpectedly when she confronts the caped crusader. (Action, Adventure, Fantasy) - 1992

5starmax.us.title: Rise of the Planet of the Apes
5starmax.us.description: Will Rodman, a scientist in San Francisco, is experimenting with a drug that he hopes will cure his father's Alzheimer's disease. After his work is deemed a failure, Will becomes the guardian of Caesar, an infant chimp who was exposed in utero to Will's drug. Caesar displays unusual intelligence, and Will decides to continue his experiments secretly. But as Caesar's intellect and abilities grow, he comes to represent a threat to man's dominion over Earth. (Science fiction, Action, Adventure) - 2011

5starmax.us.title: X-Men: First Class
5starmax.us.description: In the early 1960s, during the height of the Cold War, a mutant named Charles Xavier (James McAvoy) meets a fellow mutant named Erik Lehnsherr (Michael Fassbender). Despite their vastly different backgrounds -- Charles grew up with a wealthy family, while Erik lost his parents at Auschwitz -- the two become close friends. As the world teeters on the brink of a nuclear war, Charles and Erik with other mutants join forces to save humanity. However, a situation soon tears the friends apart. (Action, Adventure, Fantasy, Science fiction) - 2011

5starmax.us.title: The Hangover Part II
5starmax.us.description: Two years after the disastrous events in Las Vegas, it is now Stu's (Ed Helms) turn to walk down the aisle. Since his bride is from Thailand, Stu decides to hold the wedding there. Desperately hoping to avoid the mayhem of Doug's (Justin Bartha) bachelor party, Stu chooses what he thinks will be a safe option: an alcohol-free, pre-wedding brunch. But this being Thailand, and with Phil (Bradley Cooper) and Alan (Zach Galifianakis) again in attendance, anything can happen. (Comedy) - 2011

5starmax.us.title: Wedding Crashers
5starmax.us.description: Jeremy (Vince Vaughn) and John (Owen Wilson) are divorce mediators who spend their free time crashing wedding receptions. For the irrepressible duo, there are few better ways to drink for free and bed vulnerable women. So when Secretary of the Treasury William Cleary (Christopher Walken) announces the wedding of his daughter, the pair make it their mission to crash the high-profile event. But their game hits a bump in the road when John locks eyes with bridesmaid Claire (Rachel McAdams). (Romantic comedy) - 2005

5starmax.us.title: Repo Men
5starmax.us.description: In the future, medical technology has advanced to the point where people can buy artificial organs to extend their lives. But if they default on payments, an organization known as the Union sends agents to repossess the organs. Remy (Jude Law) is one of the best agents in the business, but when he becomes the recipient of an artificial heart, he finds himself in the same dire straits as his many victims. With his former partner (Forest Whitaker) in hot pursuit, Remy runs for his life. (Science fiction, Action, Thriller) - 2010

5starmax.us.title: Odd Jobs
5starmax.us.description: The summer job situation looks bleak for five college pals until they decide to start their own moving business. (Comedy) - 1986

5starmax.us.title: Ocean's 11
5starmax.us.description: Danny Ocean (Frank Sinatra) calls on some of his World War II buddies -- including Jimmy Foster (Peter Lawford), Sam Harmon (Dean Martin) and Josh Howard (Sammy Davis Jr.) -- to pull off an elaborate New Year's Eve heist at five casinos in Las Vegas. Eleven members of Danny's crew come together to pull off a perfect robbery, but they suffer a series of setbacks when Duke Santos (Cesar Romero), a former gangster, tries to thwart Ocean's plans to disappear with the money. (Comedy drama) - 1960

5starmax.us.title: Ocean's Eleven
5starmax.us.description: Dapper Danny Ocean is a man of action. Less than 24 hours into his parole from a New Jersey penitentiary, the wry, charismatic thief is already rolling out his next plan. Following three rules: Don't hurt anybody, don't steal from anyone who doesn't deserve it, and play the game like you've got nothing to lose. Danny orchestrates the most sophisticated, elaborate casino heist in history. (Comedy drama, Crime drama) - 2001

5starmax.us.title: Ocean's Twelve
5starmax.us.description: After successfully robbing five casinos in one night, Danny Ocean and his crew of thieves have big problems. Despite pulling off one of the biggest heists in Las Vegas history, the members of the gang have already spent much of the money they stole. Casino owner Terry Benedict demands that Ocean return the money, plus millions more in interest. Unable to come up the cash, the crew is forced to come together to pull off another series of heists, this time in Europe. (Comedy drama, Crime drama) - 2004

5starmax.us.title: Ocean's Thirteen
5starmax.us.description: Danny Ocean and his gang hatch an ambitious plot for revenge after ruthless casino owner Willy Bank double-crosses Reuben Tishkoff, Danny's friend and mentor. First, Ocean's gang plan to hit Bank in the paycheck by reversing the precept that the house always wins. Next, they will deal a crushing blow to Bank's ego by ruining his reputation as the only hotelier to earn the Royal Review's Five Diamond Award for each of his properties. (Comedy drama, Crime drama) - 2007

5starmax.us.title: Twin Peaks: Fire Walk With Me
5starmax.us.description: In the folksy town of Deerfield, Wash., FBI Agent Desmond (Chris Isaak) inexplicably disappears while hunting for the man who murdered a teen girl. The killer is never apprehended, and, after experiencing dark visions and supernatural encounters, Agent Dale Cooper (Kyle MacLachlan) chillingly predicts that the culprit will claim another life. Meanwhile, in the similarly cozy town of Twin Peaks, hedonistic beauty Laura Palmer (Sheryl Lee) hangs with lowlifes and seems destined for a grisly fate. (Crime drama) - 1992

5starmax.us.title: The Daytrippers
5starmax.us.description: Family members (Pat McNamara, Anne Meara) join a woman (Hope Davis) on an odyssey to confront her husband about a love letter addressed to him. - 1996

5starmax.us.title: Mississippi Masala
5starmax.us.description: People resent the romance of a black man (Denzel Washington) and an Indian woman (Sarita Choudhury) in a Mississippi town. - 1991

5starmax.us.title: Halloween H20: 20 Years Later
5starmax.us.description: In hiding for two decades, a traumatized woman (Jamie Lee Curtis) learns her murderous brother has returned for her. - 1998

5starmax.us.title: Halloween: Resurrection
5starmax.us.description: Internet users watch six collegians as they spend the night in Michael Myers' (Brad Loree) childhood home. - 2002

5starmax.us.title: Halloween: The Curse of Michael Myers
5starmax.us.description: An ancient Celtic ritual drives Dr. Loomis' (Donald Pleasence) patient to sacrifice an entire family in Haddonfield, Ill. - 1995

5starmax.us.title: Night on Earth
5starmax.us.description: Five brief encounters occur in five taxis on the same night in Los Angeles, New York, Rome, Paris and Helsinki. - 1992

5starmax.us.title: A Clockwork Orange
5starmax.us.description: Young Alex (Malcolm McDowell) and his droogs commit barbaric acts in a near-future, dehumanizing society. - 1971

Jack Jackson, a reporter desperate to save his reputation and career, is determined to find out why. In search of the truth, the two team up and unravel a growing web of institutional corruption and lies. (Crime drama, Mystery) - 2018

As the three men revisit old haunts, reflect on their glory days and try to make up for lost time, one wrestles with a terrible quandary: Doc has orders to kill Val, and time is running out for him to figure out a way out of his dilemma. (Comedy, Crime drama, Thriller) - 2012

backstage.us.title: Killing Them Softly

Frankie picks a less-than-ideal partner (Ben Mendelsohn) to help him, but despite their combined incompetence, they manage to make off with the mob's money. In retaliation, Markie's bosses hire Jackie Cogan (Brad Pitt), a mob enforcer, to eradicate those responsible. (Crime drama, Action) - 2012

bbcearth.us.description: This film goes beyond events at the Amboseli National Park, in search of elephants living in Africa's vast landscape. (Episode, Series, Documentary) - 19971012

bbcearth.us.title: Natural World - Florida: America's Animal Paradise
bbcearth.us.description: Florida is famous for its beaches, blue water and year-round sun, but it also has a surprising wild side; it is home to pine forests, coral reefs and the famous Everglades wetland, the largest subtropical wilderness in the U.S. (Episode, Series, Anthology, Nature, Documentary) - 20190407

bbcearth.us.title: Natural World - The Last Grizzly of Paradise Valley
bbcearth.us.description: Wildlife filmmaker Jeff Turner finds the Cascade Mountains under threat, especially its last grizzly bears. (Episode, Series, Anthology, Nature, Documentary) - 20110301

bbcearth.us.title: Natural World - Meerkats: Secrets of an Animal Superstar

bbcearth.us.title: Wild New Zealand - Wild New Zealand

bbcearth.us.title: Wild New Zealand - Savage Island Giants
bbcearth.us.description: Male sea lions brawl for mating rights and females give birth on a sandy beach in the Auckland Islands, located halfway between New Zealand and Antarctica. (Episode, Miniseries, Nature, Documentary) - 20170716

bbcearth.us.title: Wild New Zealand - Penguin Central
bbcearth.us.description: Four penguin species begin breeding every winter in four very different and rugged locations on New Zealand's South Island. (Episode, Miniseries, Nature, Documentary) - 20170723

bbcearth.us.title: Wild Brazil - A Dangerous World
bbcearth.us.description: Capuchin, giant otter and coatis babies take their first steps during a brief pause between seasonal extremes. (Episode, Series, Nature, Animals, Documentary) - 20140114

bbcearth.us.title: Wild Brazil - Facing the Flood

bbcearth.us.title: Wild Brazil - Enduring the Drought

bbcearth.us.title: Wild Mexico - Mountain Worlds

bbcearth.us.title: Mexico: Earth's Festival of Life - Forests of the Maya

bbcfood.us.description: S01 E01 Corsica and Sardinia Rick Stein discovers sausages and sheep's cheese and explores the locals' passion for chestnuts in Corsica.

bbcfood.us.title: Rick Stein's Mediterranean Escapes
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E02 On a misty lagoon in Sardinia Rick watches the fishermen catch mullet using the same methods as the Romans did centuries before. He boards a ferry for Sicily to find, in the heart of Palermo, one of the best pasta dishes he's ever tasted.

bbcfood.us.title: Rick Stein's Mediterranean Escapes
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E03 Sicily and Puglia Rick travels from Sicily to Puglia.

bbcfood.us.title: Rick Stein's Mediterranean Escapes
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E04 Corfu Rick departs Italy and makes his way to the Greek island of Corfu, where he attends a family feast; he visits kitchens in restaurants all over the island and learns how to make dishes such as a Greek peasant salad with feta and olives and more.

bbcfood.us.title: Rick Stein's Mediterranean Escapes
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E05 Mallorca and Catalonia In Mallorca, Rick finds wonderful seafood dishes and the most succulent roast lamb he's ever tasted, while in Barcelona he samples Catalonian food at the famous Boqueria market.

bbcfood.us.title: Rick Stein's Mediterranean Escapes
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E06 Morocco and Turkey Rick samples the delights of couscous, tagines and mint tea in Moroccan bazaars, before heading along the old silk route to south-eastern Turkey, where he tastes the finest kebabs.

bbcfood.us.title: Rick Stein's Long Weekends
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E01 Bordeaux Heading to autumnal Bordeaux; Rick arrives just in time to judge a local wine contest; he hires a 2CV for an excursion to the coast that is abundant with mussels and oysters.

bbcfood.us.title: Rick Stein's Long Weekends
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E02 Reykjavik Rick Stein heads north towards the Arctic Circle to explore the food of Reykjavík; a perfect winter break is enriched with roast lamb, rye bread baked in volcanic sand, langoustine soup and cod.

bbcfood.us.title: Rick Stein's Long Weekends
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E03 Berlin Rick enjoys a long weekend in Berlin, where history and the Avant-garde dwell side by side; a city that once made history with its divisive wall teems today with an array of innovative chefs offering seasonal creations like puréed sunflower seeds.

bbcfood.us.title: Rick Stein's Long Weekends
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E04 Vienna Rick Stein visits Vienna, the city that once ran the Austro-Hungarian Empire and continues to be home to dishes like tafelspitz and goulash; Vienna gave its name to one of Europe's most popular dishes, the wiener schnitzel.

buzzr.us.title: The Price Is Right
buzzr.us.description: "Come on down!" "The Price Is Right" -- hosted by Bob Barker until 2007 and Drew Carey thereafter -- features a wide variety of games and contests with the same basic challenge: Guess the prices of everyday (or not-quite-everyday) retail items. Four contestants, all of whom are seated in one of the wildest audiences in daytime game-show history, are called to the stage to play a preliminary pricing round. That winner joins the host on stage for one of more than 70 different pricing games. After three such games, the contestants spin a big wheel -- hoping to get as close to $1 as possible -- in the "Showcase Showdown." That's repeated in the second half of the show, and two highest winners of that round advance to the final, where prizes could be cars or roomsful of furniture. Models present the prizes. (Game show) - 1972-09-04

Following a visitor's message, Grant tries to inspire his team to use faith to conquer fear and opposing teams. (Action, Drama, Movie) - 2006-09-29

cinevault.us.title: Places in the Heart

Edna is aided by her beautician sister, Margaret; a blind boarder, Mr. Will; and a would-be thief, Moze, who decides to stick around to teach Edna how to plant and harvest cotton. (Drama, Movie) - 1984-09-21

cinevault.us.title: Eat Pray Love

Now newly divorced and facing a turning point, she finds that she is confused about what is important to her. Daring to step out of her comfort zone, Liz embarks on a quest of self-discovery that takes her to Italy, India and Bali. (Drama, Movie, Romance) - 2010-08-13

cinevault.us.title: Bram Stoker's Dracula

cinevault.us.title: Darkness Falls

Now Darkness Falls has to contend with Matilda's supernatural wrath. Childhood friends Kyle (Chaney Kley) and Caitlin (Emma Caulfield) return home to uncover the truth behind the legend after Caitlin's little brother (Lee Cormie) has recurring nightmares about Matilda. (Horror, Movie, Thriller) - 2003-01-24

As Luke recovers, he starts to realize his implant is dangerous and seeks help from Hal (Michael Ironside), the leader of a group of hackers. A shadowy executive (Val Kilmer) tries to stop Luke and Hal before they learn too much. (Action, Movie, Science fiction, Thriller) - 2009-11-03

divorcecourt.us.title: Divorce Court - Barbara Nunnally vs. Darryl Graham

divorcecourt.us.title: Divorce Court - Maya Austin vs. Tiana Dowdell

divorcecourt.us.title: Divorce Court - Sity Hogan vs. John Hogan

divorcecourt.us.title: Divorce Court - Miranda Golden vs. Chase Kerner

divorcecourt.us.title: Divorce Court - Biata Thompson vs. Quincy Thompson

divorcecourt.us.title: Divorce Court - Vanessa Jackson vs. Visall Chann

divorcecourt.us.title: Divorce Court - Grover Chad Dudley vs. Emerald Otisi

divorcecourt.us.description: Kazza says Jamal belittles her, accuses her of cheating, and demands she pay him $500, or he will walk out of their child's life; he says his demands on her are the only way he can keep a "grip" on her.

filmriseaction.us.title: K-19: The Widowmaker
filmriseaction.us.description: Follows Captain Alexei Vostrikov who, at the height of the Cold War, is ordered to take over command of the nuclear missile submarine K-19, pride of the Soviet Navy. His assignment: Prepare the K-19 for sea and take her out on patrol -- no matter what the cost. But problems with the K-19 arise that may lead to a core meltdown and explosion that will certainly kill all aboard, and possibly trigger a nuclear war. Vostrikov must choose between his orders and the lives of his men. (Thriller, Historical drama, War) - 2002

filmriseaction.us.title: Freejack
filmriseaction.us.description: Early in the 21st century, technological advances have made it possible for aging, wealthy people to pay crooks like Vacendak (Mick Jagger) to go back in time, kidnap young victims like race car driver Alex Furlong (Emilio Estevez) and deliver them to the elderly clients, who then have their brains transplanted into the healthy bodies. Furlong manages to break free from his captors, but as a fugitive, he finds that the world of the future is a bleak, dangerous place. (Science fiction) - 1992

filmriseaction.us.title: The Contract
filmriseaction.us.description: Frank Carden (Morgan Freeman), one of the world's greatest assassins, is handed a lucrative contract to kill a highly secretive billionaire. But in a twist of fate, Carden is involved in a car accident during the job, and when his gun is found after he is admitted to a hospital, federal marshals arrest him. Meanwhile, ex-cop Ray Keene (John Cusack) is hiking with his son, Chris (Jamie Anderson), when Carden's cohorts try to spring him from custody, and soon the pair is caught in the crossfire. (Thriller) - 2006

filmriseaction.us.title: Assault on Precinct 13
filmriseaction.us.description: When the LAPD kills several members of the South Central gang Street Thunder, the remaining members avenge themselves by way of a bloody war waged against cops and citizens alike. Caught in the crossfire is Lt. Ethan Bishop (Austin Stoker), who's managing a skeleton crew at the local and soon-to-be-closed police precinct. As the gang members close in, Bishop forms an unlikely alliance with a group of prisoners in order to defend the station and the lives of everyone in it. (Action) - 1976

filmriseaction.us.title: Dillinger and Capone

filmrisefreemovies.us.title: Mercenary for Justice
filmrisefreemovies.us.description: As a mercenary, John Seeger (Steven Seagal) has a reputation that precedes him. That's why he's being blackmailed into performing a risky job: breaking the son of a wealthy arms dealer out of a South African prison. With his friends taken hostage, Seeger agrees to do the deed -- but finds out too late that he's been double-crossed. Not one who likes being taken for a fool, Seeger hatches an elaborate plan to get even that will make the prison break look like capture the flag. (Family, Action, Thriller) - 2006

filmrisefreemovies.us.title: The Bone Snatcher
filmrisefreemovies.us.description: A scientist (Scott Bairstow) finds a monster that devours its prey in the deserts of South Africa. (Horror, Thriller) - 2003

filmrisefreemovies.us.title: Chef
filmrisefreemovies.us.description: After a controlling owner (Dustin Hoffman) pushes him too far, chef Carl Casper (Jon Favreau) quits his position at a prestigious Los Angeles restaurant. As he tries to figure out what his next step should be, he finds himself in Miami. Carl joins forces with his ex-wife (Sofía Vergara), best friend (John Leguizamo) and son (Emjay Anthony) to launch a food-truck business, and the venture provides a chance to reignite his passion for cooking -- as well as his zest for life and love. (Comedy drama) - 2014

filmrisefreemovies.us.title: Blitz
filmrisefreemovies.us.description: A tough cop (Jason Statham) goes after a serial killer who targets police officers. (Thriller, Crime drama, Action) - 2011

filmrisefreemovies.us.title: My Baby Gone
filmrisefreemovies.us.description: Emily, who is pregnant, quickly becomes friends with her new, pregnant neighbor. Little does Emily know that Kelly has been faking her pregnancy so she can steal her baby. (Thriller) - 2017

filmrisefreemovies.us.title: Kill Switch
filmrisefreemovies.us.description: A military experiment to harness unlimited energy goes horribly awry, leaving a pilot with no choice but to fight through an imploding world to save his family and the planet itself. (Family, Science fiction, Action, Thriller, Drama) - 2017

filmrisefreemovies.us.title: Killing Season
filmrisefreemovies.us.description: A U.S. veteran (Robert De Niro) and a former Serbian soldier (John Travolta) play cat-and-mouse games in the remote wilderness. (Thriller, Action) - 2013

filmrisefreemovies.us.title: The 51st State
filmrisefreemovies.us.description: The 51st State is the story of Elmo McElroy (Samuel L. Jackson), a streetwise American master chemist, who heads to England to set up his last big deal -- to introduce a new designer drug to the European market. McElroy soon becomes embroiled in a web of double-dealing as he's escorted around Liverpool's underworld and rave scene by rabid local hood Felix De Souza (Robert Carlyle), who hates all things American. (Action, Comedy) - 2001

filmrisefreemovies.us.title: My Mom's New Boyfriend
filmrisefreemovies.us.description: After several years away, FBI agent Henry Durand (Colin Hanks) returns to find his mother, Marty (Meg Ryan), a much different person: Having long mourned for Henry's father, she is now embracing single life. One day, while Marty, Henry and his new fiancée, Emily (Selma Blair), are out for a walk, they meet Tommy (Antonio Banderas), a mysterious stranger, with whom Marty then becomes involved. However, through his FBI contacts, Henry learns that Tommy is suspected of being an art thief. (Romantic comedy, Comedy, Crime drama, Romance) - 2008

filmrisefreemovies.us.title: Gang of Roses
filmrisefreemovies.us.description: A gang of gold-hunting outlaws, headed by the ruthless Left Eye Watkins (Bobby Brown), takes over the peaceful town of Flatridge, tearing the sleepy outpost to shreds as they search for riches. They murder a can-can girl, who is the sister of Rachel (Monica Calhoun), the onetime leader of a notorious all-girl gang. Rachel then rounds up her four old associates, and they seek revenge for her sister. Using teamwork and a sassy attitude, Rachel's gang goes up against Watkins' tough crew. (Western, Action) - 2003

filmrisefreemovies.us.title: Going All the Way
filmrisefreemovies.us.description: Korean War--era veterans and ex-classmates "Gunner" Casselman (Ben Affleck) and "Sonny" Burns (Jeremy Davies) reunite upon their return home. Gunner, who spent the war years abroad, is trying to convince his mother that his gal Marty (Rachel Weisz) is good enough for him, while Sonny, who was stationed stateside, is torn between loyal Buddy (Amy Locane) and tempting Gale Ann (Rose McGowan). As they commiserate, the men realize that they're outgrowing the lives they lived before the war. (Drama) - 1997

filmrisefreemovies.us.title: Heathers
filmrisefreemovies.us.description: Veronica (Winona Ryder) is part of the most popular clique at her high school, but she disapproves of the other girls' cruel behavior. When Veronica and her new boyfriend, J.D. (Christian Slater), confront clique leader Heather Chandler (Kim Walker) and accidentally poison her, they make it appear a suicide. Soon Veronica realizes that J.D. is intentionally killing students he does not like. She races to stop J.D. while also clashing with the clique's new leader, Heather Duke (Shannen Doherty). (Dark comedy, Crime drama) - 1989

filmrisefreemovies.us.title: The Gunman

filmrisefreemovies.us.title: The Code

filmrisefreemovies.us.title: The Devil's Arithmetic
filmrisefreemovies.us.description: Hannah Stern (Kirsten Dunst), an American-born Jewish adolescent, is uninterested in the culture, faith and customs of her relatives; however, Hannah begins to reevaluate her heritage when she has a supernatural experience that transports her back to a Nazi death camp in 1941. There, she meets a young girl named Rivkah (Brittany Murphy), a fellow captive in the camp. As Rivkah and Hannah struggle to survive in the face of daily atrocities, they form an unbreakable bond. (Drama, Fantasy, War) - 1999

filmrisefreemovies.us.title: Blind Horizon
filmrisefreemovies.us.description: Found in the New Mexico desert with a head wound and total amnesia, Frank Kavanaugh (Val Kilmer) is brought to a hospital. When he recovers some of his memory, he begins raving about an upcoming assassination attempt on the president. Despite the man's unstable state, Sheriff Jack Kolb (Sam Shepard) is troubled by Frank's story. Discovering the truth grows more complicated when Chloe Richards (Neve Campbell) arrives and claims to be Frank's fiancée, even though he has no memory of her. (Drama, Thriller, Mystery) - 2004

filmrisefreemovies.us.title: Prom Night
filmrisefreemovies.us.description: This slasher movie follows a relentless killer who is out to avenge the death of a young girl who died after being bullied and teased by four of her classmates. Now high-school students, the guilt-ridden kids have kept their involvement a secret, but when they start being murdered, one by one, it's clear that someone knows the truth. Also coping with the past are members of the dead girl's family, most notably her prom-queen sister, Kim Hammond. (Horror, Thriller) - 1980

retroplex.us.title: Sherlock Holmes and the Secret Weapon
retroplex.us.description: Sherlock Holmes (Basil Rathbone) saves noted Swiss physicist Franz Tobel (William Post Jr.) from the Gestapo in Zurich and smuggles him to London. There, Tobel is reunited with his wife, Charlotte (Kaaren Verne), to whom he gives a coded message in the event he disappears. Tobel presents the weapon he developed to government officials, and when he is subsequently abducted by arch-villain Professor Moriarty (Lionel Atwill), Holmes and Dr. Watson (Nigel Bruce) risk their lives to find him. (Mystery) - 1942

retroplex.us.title: Dressed to Kill
retroplex.us.description: Holmes and Watson hunt for three music boxes containing directions to the whereabouts of six valuable engraving plates stolen from the Bank of England. They find themselves in competition with professional thieves also out to find the clues, which were hidden by a spiteful jailbird before the music boxes went up for auction. (Mystery) - 1946

retroplex.us.title: The Woman in Green
retroplex.us.description: When a number of attractive women are found dead and with fingers missing, Sherlock Holmes (Basil Rathbone) and Dr. Watson (Nigel Bruce) investigate. Though evidence points to a psychotic killer, Holmes begins to believe that there's more to the case than initially meets the eye, a notion that leads him to uncover the involvement of his archenemy, Professor Moriarty (Henry Daniell). Who is working with Moriarty on such a dastardly plot, and what are their motives? (Mystery) - 1945

retroplex.us.title: Vengeance Valley
retroplex.us.description: Adopted by the wealthy rancher Arch Strobie, orphan Owen Daybright (Burt Lancaster) grows to be a respectable foreman on Strobie's ranch. Strobie's natural son, Lee (Robert Walker), is jealous of Owen and finally finds a way to undermine his upstanding brother. When Lee conceives an illegitimate child with Lily Fasken (Sally Forrest), who refuses to name him as the father, he tells her revenge-minded brothers that Owen is to blame, hoping they'll take his half-brother out of the picture. (Western) - 1951

retroplex.us.title: Boss
retroplex.us.description: Two ex-slave bounty hunters (Fred Williamson, D'Urville Martin) take care of business in a lawless Wild West town. (Western) - 1975

retroplex.us.title: Don't Wait, Django... Shoot!
retroplex.us.description: Django believes there is only one path for him to follow when he returns to his hometown and discovers his father has been murdered by a ruthless gang. (Action, Western) - 1967

retroplex.us.title: Bar 20 Justice
retroplex.us.description: Hopalong Cassidy gets the drop on some miners robbing ore from the heroine's mine. (Western, Drama) - 1938

retroplex.us.title: The Unforgiven
retroplex.us.description: The Zachary family live quietly on a cattle ranch in post-Civil War Texas. A stranger (Joseph Wiseman) appears and disturbs their bucolic existence by spreading a malicious rumor that their adopted daughter, Rachel (Audrey Hepburn), is a Kiowa Native American. Soon, the Zachary brothers (Audie Murphy, Burt Lancaster) and their mother (Lillian Gish) must defend themselves from both racist whites and vengeful Kiowa. (Drama, Romance, Western) - 1960

retroplex.us.title: Night of the Living Dead
retroplex.us.description: A ragtag group of Pennsylvanians barricade themselves in an old farmhouse to remain safe from a horde of flesh-eating ghouls that are ravaging the United States. (Horror) - 1968

retroplex.us.title: Cheyenne Takes Over
retroplex.us.description: U.S. Marshal Cheyenne (Al "Lash" La Rue) and his sidekick, Fuzzy (Al "Fuzzy" St. John), are en route to a much-needed vacation at Fuzzy's friend's ranch. But, upon arriving, the partners find that Fuzzy's pal has been killed, and a fishy group of characters has taken over the ranch, claiming to have inherited it from the dead man. Immediately suspicious, the lawmen team up with local saloon owner Fay Wilkins (Nancy Gates), and forgo their vacation in favor of a murder investigation. (Western) - 1947

retroplex.us.title: Texas Terror
retroplex.us.description: Just before Bess (Lucile Browne) returns home to the ranch owned by her father, Dan Matthews, robbers attack him and his friend, Sheriff John Higgins (John Wayne) -- and Dan is killed in the gunfight. Convinced that one of his shots resulted in Dan's death, John resigns as sheriff. Former sheriff Ed Williams (George Hayes) convinces John to work for Bess to make up for his error, and he becomes her foreman. John doesn't confide his involvement in her father's death, but Bess soon hears rumors. (Western) - 1935

retroplex.us.title: The Lucky Texan
retroplex.us.description: Jerry Mason (John Wayne), fresh out of college back East, heads home to Texas to join a blacksmith business with family friend Jake (George Hayes). But when they discover a gold nugget in a horseshoe, they're led down a dangerous path, as crooks Joe Cole (Yakima Canutt) and Harris (Lloyd Whitlock) scheme to take the rock from the unsuspecting Jerry and Jake. This ultimately gets Jake shot and wounded, lands Jerry in jail unjustly and leaves the pair plotting to get revenge on the criminals. (Western) - 1934

retroplex.us.title: Tumbleweed Trail
retroplex.us.description: Scheming to steal Bill Ryan's (Kermit Maynard) cattle to pay a debt, his half-brother, Brad Barton (Bob Duncan), has his men shoot the rancher. With Bill left for dead, Brad and corrupt lawyer Alton Small (Ted Adams) produce a forged will that disinherits Bill's teenage daughter, Robin (Shirley Patterson), and son Freckles (Johnny McGovern). Aid arrives in the form of cowboys Eddie Dean (Eddie Dean) and Soapy Jones (Roscoe Ates), who help Robin fight for her rightful property. (Western) - 1946
